incidents.title: Turkmenistan and China Cooperation in Combating Desertification
incidents.description: To combat desertification, specialists from the National Institute of Deserts, Flora and Fauna (NIDFF) of Turkmenistan and the Xinjiang Institute of Ecology and Geography of the Chinese Academy of Sciences have increased scientific exchange within the framework of the Belt and Road initiative, reports the Turkmenistan News Portal.

incidents.title: Multimodal Transport Corridor to China Launched in Uzbekistan
incidents.description: A multimodal transport corridor connecting Central Asia with China and Europe will be piloted by a shipment of 10 trucks traveling from Uzbekistan, through Tajikistan, to China. A logistics center will be created at the Jartepa-Sarazm section of the border, capable of handling up to 100 trucks per day and accelerating the process of processing the necessary documents with the goal of increasing capacity of the crossing point.

incidents.title: Agreement Signed for Production, Educational, and Research Cooperation
incidents.description: A strategic partnership and cooperation agreement was signed between the Almalyk State Technical Institute and the mining and construction materials company CONCH Cement, according to Review.uz. This agreement allows for the exchange of experience in the production, educational, and research spheres with Chinese scientists and the possibility for joint projects in the field of mining electromechanics.

incidents.title: Border Attack Leads to Suspension of Construction on the Dushanbe-China International Highway
incidents.description: Construction of a section of the Dushanbe-China international highway in the Darvaz district of the Gorno-Badakhshan Autonomous Region (GBAO) was suspended in response to the armed attacks from Afghanistan's border against Chinese workers, according to Radio Azattyz. The Ministry of Transport of Tajikistan confirmed the suspension of construction work in a written response to Radio Ozodi, the Tajik service of RFE/RL).

incidents.title: Studying in China Gives Kazakh Students Competitive Edge
incidents.description: Competitive advantage for Kazakh students to study in China was discussed during a meeting between Consul General in Shanghai Nurlan Akkoshkarov and Kazakh students studying at universities across the consular district of the Consulate General of the Republic of Kazakhstan in Shanghai, according to DKnews. Focus was given relating national priorities to the need for specialists with proficiency in the Chinese language and experience of studying in China.

incidents.title: Delegation from the China-Central Asia Cooperation Center for Combating Desertification visits Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Tajikistan, and Kyrgyzstan
incidents.description: A delegation from the China-Central Asia Cooperation Center for Combating Desertification visited Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Tajikistan, and Kyrgyzstan to deepen cooperation in ecology and the environment, as reported by DKnews.kz. The visit resulted in several agreements aimed at expanding practical cooperation in the areas of desertification prevention and control, forest fire prevention, and pest management, according to the news portal Zhongguo Xinwenwang,.

incidents.title: Construction of the Dushanbe–Khorog–Kulma highway remains suspended
incidents.description: Construction of the Qalai-Khumb-Vanj section of the Dushanbe–Khorog–Kulma highway remains suspended for the second consecutive month and is set to resume only after security is restored along the Tajik-Afghan border, reports AsiaPlus citing the Ministry of Transport.

incidents.title: First TITR Freight Train of 2026 Departed from Xi'an International Port Station
incidents.description: The first China-Europe freight train of 2026, running along the Trans-Caspian International Transport Route (TITR) and passing through Kazakhstan, departed from the Xi'an International Port station in the administrative center of Shaanxi province in the northwest of China, DKNews.kz reports. The China-Europe (Xi'an) train creates a more efficient international logistics channel when compared to traditional sea transport; the delivery time decreased from two months to 11 days.

incidents.title: Lianyungang Port Maintains Leading Position as Logistics Hub
incidents.description: By the end of 2025, China-Europe/Asia (915 total) freight trains had transported 75,030 standard containers from the China-Kazakhstan logistics base in Lianyungang Port (Jiangsu Province, East China), allowing it to maintain its leading position in the province, according to Xinhua.

incidents.title: Meeting Between Chairman of the Board of JSC NC Kazakhstan Temir Zholy and Ambassador of the People's Republic of China
incidents.description: Chairman of the Board of JSC NC Kazakhstan Temir Zholy (Kazakhstan Railways) met with the Ambassador of the People's Republic of China In Kazakhstan to emphasize the development of the Trans-Caspian International Transport Route (TITR, Middle Corridor), as reported by rail-news.kz.

incidents.title: Cultural Heritage Seminar Held Between Kazakhstan and China
incidents.description: An international seminar dedicated to the preservation and promotion of intangible cultural heritage, as well as the development of intercultural communication between Kazakhstan and China, was held in Beijing. The event was organized with the support of the Embassy of Kazakhstan in China and the Cultural Center of the Republic of Kazakhstan in Beijing, together with the National Association Qazaq-Oner, DKNews.kz reports.

incidents.title: Flight Route Opens from Kashgar to Tashkent
incidents.description: The first flight on a new passenger route from Kashgar-- the administrative center of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region-- to Tashkent took place on 14 January, reports Xinhua. The round-trip flight will operate weekly and coincides with the visa-free agreement between Uzbekistan and China.

incidents.title: Training Course Held at Weinan Vocational and Technical College
incidents.description: In China, a training course was held at Weinan Vocational and Technical College and attended by representatives from five Central Asian countries, including Kyrgyzstan, according to open.kg.

incidents.title: Meeting Held Between Tajik State Pedagogical University and the Vocational and Technical Institute of the Defense Industry of Shaanxi Province
incidents.description: Representatives from Tajik State Pedagogical University and the Vocational and Technical Institute of the Defense Industry of Shaanxi Province of the People's Republic of China met to discuss expansion of scientific and educational cooperation. No formal agreements were signed.

incidents.title: KazMunayGas Redirects 300,000 Tons of Oil
incidents.description: KazMunayGas redirected approximately 300,000 tons of oil through the KazTransOil system in December 2025 due to restrictions on supplies through the Caspian Pipeline Consortium. Due to ongoing restrictions, this will continue with the redirection efforts in January 2026, according to ArbatMedia.

incidents.title: China and Tajikistan Deepen Education Cooperation
incidents.description: A Memorandum of Cooperation and educational exchange has been signed between the Institute of Economics and Trade of the Tajik State University of Commerce in Khujand and the Guilin University of Technology in the People's Republic of China, according to Avesta in reference to the Institute of Economics and Trade of the Tajik State University of Commerce in Khujand.

incidents.title: Joint Initiative between Kozybayev University and the Henan Agricultural Investment Group
incidents.description: A Kazakh-Chinese scientific agricultural center will open as a joint initiative between Kozybayev University and the Henan Agricultural Investment Group, according to DKNewz. It will facilitate the development of agriculture in Northern Kazakhstan where the agricultural sector plays one of the key roles in the economy. Chinese colleagues arrived in Kazakhstan for a return visit following a memorandum of cooperation that was signed last November.

incidents.title: New Bridge to Connect Russia and China through Kazakhstan
incidents.description: Kazakhstan will construct a new road-bridge in the Shemonaikha district of the East Kazakhstan region, according to Channel Seven. The bridge will replace the old one that currently transports goods between China and Russia, strengthening the East Transit Corridor.

incidents.title: Kuryk Port Receives Additional Funding
incidents.description: The Chinese company Guoyou Materials Group will invest more than $1 billion in the development of the Kuryk port.

incidents.title: Tajikistan's Minister of Energy and Water Resources Meets with the Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the PRC
incidents.description: The Tajik Minister of Energy and Water Resources held a meeting with the Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the People's Republic of China to the Republic of Tajikistan, during which issues of bilateral cooperation in the fields of energy and water resources, the implementation of investments and joint projects, and the use of Chinese experience were discussed, according to the Ministry of Energy and Water Resources of the Republic of Tajikistan.

incidents.title: Fifth International Management Forum to Take Place
incidents.description: With the support of IT Park Uzbekistan, the fifth international management forum will take place in Tashkent with top managers and experts from the USA, Germany, Switzerland, Italy, Russia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, and Uzbekistan present, reports IT PARK Uzbekistan.

incidents.title: Kazakhstan and China Develop Draft Agreement on Water Cooperation
incidents.description: Kazakhstan and China are developing a draft agreement on water sharing on transboundary rivers, as announced by the First Vice-Minister of Water Resources and Irrigation of Kazakhstan, Nurlan Aldamzharov at a press conference at the Central Communications Service. The negotiations will ensure that the water flow in the Ili River is maintained at the average long-term level, using Lake Balkhash as an example.

incidents.title: China Offers 73 Education Grants to Kazakh Citizens
incidents.description: China will offer 73 educational grants for Kazakh students looking to study in China for the 2026-27 year in accordance with the Agreement on Cooperation in the Field of Education between the Ministry of Education and Science of the Republic of Kazakhstan and the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China, signed in 2003.

incidents.title: Turkmenistan Loses Position as Top Natural Gas Supplier to China
incidents.description: Turkmenistan lost its position as the top supplier of natural gas to China to Russia, according to Fergana News.

incidents.title: World Bank Lends Support to Establishing Central Asian Energy Market
incidents.description: World Bank authorizes $143 million spending over next decade to increase energy trade between Central Asian states. Funds will increase transmission capacity and improve grid reliability.

incidents.title: A Train Loaded with Festive Goods Arrives in China from Kazakhstan
incidents.description: A China-Europe train loaded with Kazakh-produced festive goods (grain, oil, honey, dried noodles, beer, and snacks) arrived at the Xi'an International Port "Changba," for the Chinese New Year from Kazakhstan Ulysmedia.kz reports.

incidents.title: Tajik Citizens Increasingly Motivated to Learn Chinese
incidents.description: Reasons for Tajiks learning Chinese is changing from doing so out of pure interest to seeing large economic benefit, as commented on by AsiaPlus, a privately owned Tajik news outlet.

incidents.title: Samruk-Kazyna JSC meets with the ZTE Corporation
incidents.description: A meeting took place in China between the chairman of the Board of Samruk-Kazyna JSC, Nurlan Zhakupov, and the President of ZTE Corporation, according to Samruk-Kazyna Joint Stock Company. They discussed strategic partnership and high-tech cooperation in the fields of 5G, artificial intelligence, digital transformation, as well as confirmed mutual interest in expanding joint projects.

incidents.title: Samruk-Kazyna JSC meets with Guodong Network Communication
incidents.description: The chairman of the Board of Samruk-Kazyna JSC, held a meeting in Beijing with the founder of Guodong Network Communication Group, Lu Jie, during which the parties discussed Guodong's cooperation plans with the fund's portfolio company, JSC Kazakhtelecom, and possible areas of collaboration in the field of telecommunications and digital infrastructure.

incidents.title: Tajik and Chinese Specialists Exchange Knowledge in Water supply and Sanitation
incidents.description: Specialists from the State Unitary Enterprise "Obu Koresi Dushanbe" visited Harbin, People's Republic of China to exchange knowledge regarding the development of water supply and sanitation systems, the State Unitary Enterprise "Obu Koresi Dushanbe" reported to NIAT Khovar.

incidents.title: Energy and Construction Cooperation Discussed between Fergana Regional Governor and Chinese Investors
incidents.description: A meeting took place between the Fergana regional governor, Khairullo Bozorov, and Chinese investors working in the construction and energy sectors. The Chinese delegation was met with praise from Borozon as it presented project proposals to establish production of high-quality cable products, manufacture cement and concrete products for the construction industry, participate in construction projects for the "New Uzbekistan" residential complex being built in Margilan, develop renewable energy sources through the construction of wind power plants, modernize city street lighting systems, and install modern energy-saving lamps. Following the meeting, the parties agreed to begin implementing the agreed-upon projects as soon as possible.

incidents.title: Green Power Agreement Between Kazakhstan and China Moves Toward Full Ratification
incidents.description: The lower house of the Kazakh Parliament ratified an agreement between the governments of Kazakhstan and China on the implementation of 4 green energy power plants, which was signed on November 12, 2024, in Baku, according to the lower house of the Kazakh Parliament. The agreement encompasses the construction of three wind power plants with a total capacity of 1.5 GW and one solar power plant with a capacity of 0.3 GW. The projects will cover the Karaganda, Turkestan, and Pavlodar regions, and attract investments exceeding $2 billion.

incidents.title: Agreement on Ancient History of the Kyrgyz People Reached with Chinese Institution
incidents.description: Kyrgyz State Secretary met with the President of the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences (CASS), Gao Xiang, a member of the Central Committee of the 20th Congress of the Communist Party of China, and the head of one of China's leading think tanks, according to 24.kg, citing the presidential administration's press service. The sides discussed prospects for cooperation between think tanks and the scientific communities of Kyrgyzstan and China, and reached an agreement on joint research on the ancient and medieval history of the Kyrgyz people.

incidents.title: Discussions Held for Joint Investment Wind Farm Construction in the Pavlodar Region
incidents.description: A joint investment project for the construction of wind farms in the Pavlodar region was discussed at a meeting between Nurlan Zhakupov, Chairman of the Board of JSC Samruk-Kazyna and Cheng Habin, Deputy CEO of the Chinese state-owned energy corporation State Power Investment Corporation (SPIC). The wind farm will have a projected capacity of 1 GW and its commissioning is scheduled for Q2 2029.

incidents.title: Kazakh Train Operators Being Trained in China
incidents.description: 20 future light rail network (LRT) train operators from Kazakhstan are being trained in Tianjin, China. The LRT project in Astana is being implemented with the participation of Chinese companies, including the Tianjin Rail Transport Corporation and is the first LRT in Astana as well as in broader Central Asia, as reported by Xinhua.

incidents.title: Chinese Company to Facilitate Modernization Project of the Uch-Kurgan Hydroelectric Power Plant
incidents.description: As part of the modernization project of the Uch-Kurgan hydroelectric power plant, with the help of the Chinese company CNEEC (China National Electric Engineering Co. Ltd.), parallel reconstruction of two hydro units will be carried out according to open.kg, citing the press service of JSC Electric Stations.

incidents.title: China Deepens Rhetoric Manipulation Ability in Uzbekistan
incidents.description: The president of the Xinhua news agency noted that the Chinese news outlet is ready to deepen cooperation with Uzbek media outlets and think tanks in order to “jointly tell true, vivid, and compelling stories of friendly cooperation between China and Uzbekistan” while meeting with Uzbekistan's ambassador to China, as reported by Xinhua.

incidents.title: Kazakh Goods Delayed at Chinese Border, China Cites Non-compliance
incidents.description: Feed meal exporters are reporting train delays and cargo returns at the Chinese border under the pretext of non-compliance with standards, as reported by the Ministry of Agriculture of the Republic of Kazakhstan, citing Chairman of the Board of the National Association of Exporters "KazGrain.” The Grain Union believes that the Chinese Government is deliberately slowing down the import of feed meal due to concerns regarding increased supplies from Kazakhstan. However, after clarification and documentation was provided, the matter was resolved and all products were cleared for import into China, according to the Kazakh Ministry of Agriculture in a commentary sent to the APK News agency.

incidents.title: Kazakh Professors Complete AI Internship Program in Wuhan
incidents.description: 20 college instructors from Kazakhstan completed an internship in artificial intelligence at the Wuhan Professional Software Engineering College. As part of the program, participants visited leading IT and manufacturing companies in Wuhan, where they learned about the practical application of artificial intelligence technologies including the issues of state policy in the field of artificial intelligence, modern teaching methods and software technologies, and practical training in the field of smart cars and cross-border e-commerce.

incidents.title: Launch of International Air Route from Osh to Kashgar Scheduled for April 2026
incidents.description: A new international air route from Osh to Kashgar is scheduled to launch in April 2026, as discussed at a working meeting between representatives of the Commercial Aircraft Corporation of China (COMAC).

incidents.title: Chinese Companies to Facilitate Modernization of 3 Uzbek Hydroelectric Power Plants
incidents.description: Uzbekistan’s state-owned hydroelectric power company, Uzbekhydroenergo JSC, signed agreements for the modernization of various hydroelectric facilities on turnkey basis. First, TBEA Co., LTD, a leading international Chinese energy company, signed agreements to modernize 3 facilities of the "Lower Bozsuv HPP Cascade" hydropower plant in the Tashkent region. It is estimated that the total capacity will increase by 5 MW, providing more than 21 thousand households with electricity per year, saving 17 million m3 of natural gas and more than 40 thousand tons of coal.

incidents.title: Kyrgyzstan Implements E-permits to Facilitate Travel with China, Central Asian States
incidents.description: Kyrgyzstan's Ministry of Transport and Communications has implemented an electronic permit system that will simplify the cross-border transport of cargo, reduce corruption vulnerability, and save money.

incidents.title: China to Facilitate Training in Uzbekistan's Automotive Industry
incidents.description: Following a visit to China, a delegation from Gulistan State University signed a memorandum of cooperation with China's Beifang Automotive Education Groupaimed at strengthening professional education in the automotive industry, reports a Dunyo news agency correspondent.

incidents.title: AI OIC Meeting, Kyrgyzstan and Uzbekistan Transport Ministers Talk
incidents.description: Following a visit to China, a delegation from Gulistan State University signed a memorandum of cooperation with China's Beifang Automotive Education Group aimed at strengthening professional education in the automotive industry, reports a Dunyo news agency correspondent.

incidents.title: Kyrgyz Minister of Education Discusses Education Cooperation with the Chinese Ambassador
incidents.description: Minister of Education of Kyrgyzstan held a meeting with China's Ambassador to Kyrgyzstan to discuss cooperation in the realm of education, focusing particularly on pre-school, general school and primary vocational education, as well as the expansion of practical partnership mechanisms.

incidents.title: Kyrgyz Minister of Transport and Communications Notes Importance of the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan Railway
incidents.description: The Minister of Transport and Communications of the Kyrgyz Republic, Abdykalyk Syrgabaev, noted the importance of the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway project while speaking at the meeting of the transport ministers of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation, reports open.kg.

incidents.title: Tajikistan Hosts Chinese Lunar New Year Celebrations
incidents.description: The Embassy of the People's Republic of China held an event to celebrate Lunar New Year. Similarly, the Russian-Tajik Slavic University (RSTU) hosted a celebratory cultural and educational event, "Chinese New Year," with both the Rector Professor Ilkhomuddin Ibrohimzoda and Director of the Confucius Institute at Tajik National University Sun Jing giving speeches that emphasized the importance of preserving and promoting Chinese culture. Prior to the event, the two held meetings to discuss developing international educational cooperation and implementing joint educational initiatives and research.

incidents.title: China Donates Literary Works to Uzbek Institute
incidents.description: Literary works by the Chairman of the People's Republic of China Xi Jinping, publications on human rights, 56 books and 6 electronic e-books dedicated to Chinese culture and literature were donated to Institute of State and Law of the Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Uzbekistan, as reported by Yuz.uz, citing the press service of the National Center Republic of Uzbekistan on Human Rights. This collection comes from the recent donation of books by the Embassy of the People's Republic of China to to the Human Rights House.

incidents.title: Enhancing Border Crossing Efficiency Discussed between Kazakhstan and China
incidents.description: Discussion for improving the efficiency of border crossing points between Kazakhstan and China as a means of keeping up with rapid increase road freight traffic took place at a meeting between Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of National Economy Serik Zhumangarin. Estimates place extending overlapping operating hours between the Kazakh and Chinese sides as increasing throughput by at least 20%.

incidents.title: Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan Foreign Ministers Emphasize Importance of Economic Cooperation in Meeting
incidents.description: Kazakhstan and Kyrgzstan's foreign ministers discussed area of future cooperation, highlighting that previous efforts at integration are bearing fruit, with mutual trade reaching $2 billion.

incidents.title: Kyrgyz-Tajikistan Council Meeting Seeks Move Past Conflict, Increase Trade
incidents.description: Kyrgz Chairman of the Cabinet of Minister Adylbek Kasymaliev met with Tajikistan Prime Minister Kokhir Rasulzoda at a meeting. Fresh off the deal that resolved their border dispute, they agreed to aim for $500 million in 2026 trade and to modernize border and customs infrastructure.

incidents.title: Consular Meeting Held in Shanghai with Kazakhstan
incidents.description: Discussions were held regarding a Practical Action Plan between the Almaty Akimat and the Shanghai City Hall for 2026–2028, which will promote development in trade and economic cooperation, investment activities, and cultural and humanitarian ties.

incidents.title: Kazakhstan and Tajikistan Eye Further Dialogue on Cooperation, Trade
incidents.description: Kazakhstan and Tajikistan's foreign ministers discussed areas of future cooperation in a meeting in Dushanbe. A particular emphasis was put on expanding bilateral trade, and renewing cooperation in energy and water management. Increasing support for eachother's initiatives in international institutions such as the UN, CIS, CSTO, and OIC was also discussed. At the conclusion of talks an agreement outlining priorities for future negotiation in 2026-2028 was signed.

incidents.title: Students from Xijing University to Study Russian and Kazakh Languages
incidents.description: Three students from Xijing University in the People's Republic of China arrived at the Innovative University of Eurasia in Pavlodar as part of a Russian and Kazakh language internship and academic exchange program.

incidents.title: Chinese Experts to Speak at the Agrodialogue 2026 Forum in Bishkek
incidents.description: Experts from China, Qatar, and other neighboring countries will present reports on improving irrigation systems, introducing high-yielding seed varieties, new livestock farming methods, and export strategies at The AgroDialogue-2026 agro-industrial forum held in Bishkek from Feb. 18-20.

incidents.title: Jibek Joly TV Channel Becomes Broadcast Partner for the Spring Festival
incidents.description: Jibek Joly TV channel has become a partner in the broadcast of the Spring Festival gala concert on the Chinese television channel CGTN, Kazinform reports.

incidents.title: Kazakh Government Announces Three CHP Plants to be Built with Chinese Partners
incidents.description: The Kazakh government announced that three CHP plants in Kokshetau, Semey, and Ust-Kamenogorsk will be built jointly with Chinese partners, and not with Russians as previously planned, according to the Center for Countering Disinformation of the NSDC of Ukraine.

incidents.title: The Kazakh Senate Ratifies Renewable Energy Law with China
incidents.description: The Kazakh Senate ratified a law "On the Ratification of the Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan and the Government of the People's Republic of China on the Implementation of Renewable Energy Projects" which encompasses the construction of two wind power plants and one solar power plant in the Pavlodar, Karaganda, and Turkestan regions, reports a correspondent for the Kapital.kz business information center. The projects are scheduled for completion in 2027–2029, and Samruk-Energy JSC will act as the Kazakh co-investor, with the total investment exceeding $2 billion.

incidents.title: Kazakhstani Auto Market Faces Large-scale "gray" Imports
incidents.description: The Kazakhstani auto market is facing large-scale "gray" imports as the difference between Chinese and Kazakh statistics on car shipments from China has reached 51,500 vehicles, according to Kursiv and Energy From. Furthermore, EnergyProm highlights that the China Automobile Association (CPCA) declared 211,500 cars imported into Kazakhstan, while Kazakh authorities only recorded 160,000 imported vehicles from China. The overall import of passenger vehicles, from January to December of 2025, reached 231,900, which is 1.5 times higher than in 2024, meaning gray imports could be coming not just from China.

incidents.title: International Student Research Conference "China on the Path to Modernity" Held at the B.N. Yeltsin Kyrgyz-Russian Slavic University
incidents.description: The international student research conference "China on the Path to Modernity" was held at the B.N. Yeltsin Kyrgyz-Russian Slavic University, during which participants discussed key aspects of the PRC's development, including its strategic priorities and influence on international political and economic processes, as well as social and cultural changes in Chinese society, reports open.kg. The participants received certificates of completion of the conference.

incidents.title: Chinese AI Robot Developer Plans to Enter the Central Asian Market
incidents.description: Chinese anthropomorphic robot maker, Galbot, plans to collaborate with Central Asian countries to introduce embodied artificial intelligence systems into the economy and healthcare, Kazinform's Beijing correspondent reports, citing Renmin Huabao.

incidents.title: National Olympic Committees of Kazakhstan and China Meet
incidents.description: A working meeting between the leadership of the National Olympic Committees of Kazakhstan and China took place in Milan, focusing on a mutual goal of strengthening positions on the global stage through joint training camps (boxing and diving), reports DKNews.kz. Following the meeting, the parties confirmed their readiness to continue direct dialogue and implement joint initiatives within the Olympic movement.

incidents.title: Modernization of Dostyk Railway Station
incidents.description: The Dostyk railway station, located on the Kazakhstan-China international transport corridor, is going through a large-scale infrastructure modernization program, according to AZERTAC, citing the Ministry of Transport of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

incidents.title: China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan Railway Through Public Funding
incidents.description: Former prime minister of Kyrgyzstan proposed the idea of financing the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway with public funds, where Kyrgyzstan's portion of the project (24.5%) could be partially available to the public for share purchasing, effectively reducing external borrowing/debt and providing a lucrative investment opportunity for citizens, according to open.kg. Instead of paying interest to foreign creditors, the state will be able to pay dividends to its citizens, whose expected return could be 15-25% per annum, while further bolstering the state's economic sovereignty.

incidents.title: 98,000 Chinese Cars Projected to be Sold in Kazakhstan in 2026
incidents.description: The CEO of Orbis Auto stated that 98,000 Chinese cars are projected to be sold in Kazakhstan in 2026, which will amount to 42% of the auto market, reports national business.kz. Furthermore, in 2025, 85,408 new Chinese-brand cars were sold in Kazakhstan, with the share of total car sales amounting to 38.4%, indicating a growth trend for 2026.

incidents.title: The National Central Museum of the Republic of Kazakhstan Features Chinese New Year Artwork
incidents.description: The National Central Museum of the Republic of Kazakhstan (NCM RK) opened a children's art exhibition, featuring artwork coinciding with the Spring Festival (Chinese New Year) and the Lantern Festival, according to Xinhua. Acting Consul General of the People's Republic of China in Almaty, Lü Yi, noted that “Children are the youngest ambassadors of culture, whose drawings sometimes speak louder than words” (Xinhua).

incidents.title: Reconstruction of the Lebedinovskaya Hydroelectric Power Plant
incidents.description: Chakan Hydroelectric Power Plant (CHPP) has signed a contract with China National Heavy Machinery Corporation (CHMC) for the reconstruction of the Lebedinovskaya Hydroelectric Power Plant, one of the oldest operating hydroelectric power plants in the Chui Region, according to knews.kg. The project is currently in the design preparation and estimate creation stages, but once completed will improve the plant's reliability and efficiency, boosting capacity from 7.6MV to 10 MV and increasing annual electricity generation from 37.2 million kWh to 53.5 million kWh.

incidents.title: Ashgabat Hosts a Chinese New Year Festival
incidents.description: The Embassy of China, in cooperation with the Ministry of Culture of Turkmenistan, organized a festive concert, an exhibition, and master classes to celebrate the Chinese New Year, as reported by Turmenportal.

incidents.title: Kazakhstan is Expanding its International Flight Route Network
incidents.description: Kazakhstan is expanding its international flight route network in 2026, with Air Astana launching flights from Almaty to Shanghai (from March 29) and Astana to Guangzhou (from June 2), and FlyArystan launching flights from Almaty to Xi'an (pending slot approval) and Aktau – Urumqi ( in June), according to the Civil Aviation Committee of the Ministry of Transport of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

incidents.title: Discussions Held in Dushanbe to Deepen Scientific and Analytical Cooperation with Chinese Representatives
incidents.description: A number of agreements and memoranda of understanding meant to deepen scientific cooperation between the Center for Strategic Studies under the President of the Republic of Tajikistan and analytical and research institutions in China were signed between representatives of the Embassy of the People's Republic of China in the Republic of Tajikistan and the Center

incidents.title: Kazakhstan's Largest Tourism Investment Projects Involve Chinese Businesses
incidents.description: Three of Kazakhstan's largest tourism investment projects, including the Hilton Hotel in Shymkent (30 billion tenge), the Mandarin Oriental Astana (300 billion tenge), and the Zhibek Zholy entertainment center on the shores of Lake Kapchagay (53.3 billion tenge), involve Chinese businesses, according to Kursiv. The construction of a Mandarin Oriental hotel in Astana has not been previously reported and is receiving the largest amount of investments.

incidents.title: Uzbekistan's President Announces $1 billion Investment from China in Coal Industry
incidents.description: The President of Uzbekistan announced the intention of Chinese investors to allocate 1 billion dollars for the exploration of coal reserves, with four developments planned in the Sariasiyo district: "Qorakon," "Jemsonit," "Chukur," and "Bayram-1", according to the president’s telegram channel and spot. The area's solid fuel reserves are estimated at 100 million tons, but only 1% of this volume is currently being extracted. To properly utilize these resources, relevant ministries have been tasked with launching production at the "Sanjir" (in Boysun) and "Aksuv" (in Alynsay) mines this year, as well as starting the development of the "Fangarta" deposit in 2027.

incidents.title: The Kazakh Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation Training is Training Specialists in China and Europe
incidents.description: A group of Kazakh water specialists completed courses on developing diplomatic competencies at the Renmin University of China in Beijing in Dec. 2025. Currently, in collaboration with the Delft Institute for Water Education (IHE Delft), the Young Water Diplomats program is being implemented, in which Kazakhstani specialists are trained in the Netherlands.

incidents.title: Scientists from Russia, Kazakhstan, and China Participate in 16th International Ural Seminar "Radiation Physics of Metals and Alloys"
incidents.description: The 16th International Ural Seminar "Radiation Physics of Metals and Alloys," held in Kadnikovo, Sverdlovsk Region (Russia), brought together 76 leading experts and young researchers from Russia, Kazakhstan, and China.

incidents.title: Kyrgyzstan’s Largest Oil Refinery is Chinese Owned and Set to be Completed by August 2026
incidents.description: The modernization of Kyrgyzstan’s largest oil refinery, "Junda," owned by the Chinese investment company The China Petrol Company, is set to be completed by July 31, 2026. The funding for this project was increased by the Chinese investor to 193.7 million dollars, and the refinery will mainly produce automotive fuel that meets the new environmental standard K5.

incidents.title: Chinese Contractor to Facilitate Construction of Water Treatment Facilities in Chui Agro-industrial Zone
incidents.description: A contract was signed for the construction of water treatment facilities in the Chui agro-industrial zone, reports open.kg, citing the press service of the Kyrgyz Ministry of Water Resources, Agriculture, and Processing Industry. While JSC "Kyrgyz Agroholding is responsible for coordinating the zone’s development, the main contractor is China Road, which will handle design, equipment supply, as well as installation and construction

incidents.title: Turkmenistan Opens Border for Safe Transit of Foreign Citizens Leaving Iran
incidents.description: Turkmenistan has opened its state border for the safe transit of foreign citizens leaving Iran, including 15 citizens of Kazakhstan, 13 from Uzbekistan, 23 from South Korea, 8 from Russia and 25 from China, according to business.com.tm and Xinhua.

incidents.title: Turkmenistan's Ambassador to China Meets with Chinese Assistant Minister of Foreign Affairs
incidents.description: Turkmenistan's Ambassador to the People's Republic of China met with Chinese Assistant Minister of Foreign Affairs, according to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan. The parties' exchange of views on the current state and prospects of bilateral relations between Turkmenistan and the PRC, while emphasizing shared cultural and spiritual values and the need for continuing harmonious relations.

incidents.title: "Warm Welcome to the Spring Festival: Together, Singing the Melody of Friendship between China and Kazakhstan"
incidents.description: In honor of the Chinese New Year and in anticipation of Nauryz, a concert titled "Warm Welcome to the Spring Festival: Together, Singing the Melody of Friendship between China and Kazakhstan," was held at the Zhambyl Kazakh State Philharmonic in Almaty, reports kt.kz.

incidents.title: New Director Selected for Major Kazakh Oil and Gas Company
incidents.description: The Kazakh oil and gas company Maten Petroleum instated Zhi Cheng as director, replacing independent director Delatour Grace Fan. The company is owned by Sino-Science Netherlands Energy Group B.V., which is a subsidiary of the Chinese company, Geo-Jade Petroleum Corporation.

incidents.title: Chinese Ink Painting Exhibit to Open at National Historical Museum of the Kyrgyz Republic
incidents.description: An exhibition titled "The Free Flight of the Horse - The Spirit of Chinese Ink Painting" will open on March 10 at the National Historical Museum of the Kyrgyz Republic, according to open.kg. Visitors will be able to see about 50 works by renowned masters of Chinese ink painting, dedicated to the Year of the Fire Horse according to the Chinese lunar calendar. The event is being organized with the support of the Ministry of Culture, the National Historical Museum of the Kyrgyz Republic, the Chinese Cultural Center in Bishkek, the Center for Cultural and Tourism Exchange between China and foreign countries, and the Beijing Association for Investment and Financing in the Cultural Sector.

incidents.title: Construction of Modern Agro-logistics Center in the Akmola Region
incidents.description: The head of Kazakhstan Railways met with the leadership of the Chinese holding company SPSI Cloud Port Development and discussed the construction of a modern agro-logistics center in the Akmola region, reports LS. The project envisions the creation of a modern logistics complex on a 40-hectare site with a design capacity of over 1 million tons of cargo per year. The new hub will become a key link in the supply chain between Kazakhstan and Sichuan Province (China) and the city of Chengdu, one of the largest economic centers in western China. Chinese investment in the project is not yet known, and construction timelines have also not been announced.

incidents.title: Kyrgyz Cabinet of Ministers Amend Government Resolution Referring to a Ban on Oil Import by Road
incidents.description: The Cabinet of Ministers of the Kyrgyz Republic amended Government Resolution No. 566 of October 22, 2019, which refers to a ban on the import of oil and types of petroleum products by road. The amendment exempts gasoline and diesel fuel imported from China through state border checkpoints until December 31st, 2026, reports 24.kg. While government restrictions have previously prevented certain fuel transport by roads, the disruption in the Strait of Hormuz and global oil exports are forcing countries to adapt to ensure energy security.

incidents.title: The "Golden age" in Kyrgyz-Chinese Bilateral Relations
incidents.description: Speaker of the Jogorku Kenesh of the Kyrgyz Republic, Marlen Mamataliev, met with the Chinese Ambassador, Liu Jiangping, and emphasized that strengthening ties between the two neighboring nations is an important focus of Kyrgyzstan's foreign policy, reports open.kg. Liu, in turn, declared the beginning of a "golden age" in bilateral relations between the two countries. While it was said that agreements had been reached on several joint investment projects, specifics were not discussed.

incidents.title: Oil Transportation Through Kazakh Pipelines Reach Significant Milestones
incidents.description: Since its commissioning, the volume of oil transported through the Atasu-Alashankou main oil pipeline has exceeded 200 million tons, through the Kenkiyak-Kumkol pipeline – 100 million tons, and through the Kenkiyak-Atyrau pipeline – 100 million tons, reports KazMunayGaz. These production figures highlight the efficient and stable operation of the pipeline systems, and the willingness of customers like China to encourage innovation and reliably purchase products.

incidents.title: Talks for Reconstructing the Rushan-Varshez section of the Dushanbe-Kulma Highway
incidents.description: The reconstruction and modernization of the Dushanbe-Kulma highway on the Rushan-Varshez section—which is part of the international multimodal corridor "China-Tajikistan-Uzbekistan-Turkmenistan-Iran-Turkey-Europe-- was discussed at a meeting between Tajikistan's Minister of Transport, Azim Ibrohim, and a delegation from the Islamic Development Bank, according to Tajikistan’s official state news agency, Khovar.

incidents.title: Kazakhstan Presents New Infrastructure Technologies at Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation Program (CAREC) in China
incidents.description: Kazakhstan has presented initiatives to introduce new technologies in the road sector during the first meeting of the Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation Program (CAREC) Road Working Group in Urumqi, China, according to Kursiv in reference to the Kazakh Ministry of Transport.

incidents.title: Kazakhstan Switches from Russian Energy Supplies, Prefers Chinese
incidents.description: Kazakhstan made China's Harbin Electric International the new equipment supplier for the state district power plant, Ekibastuz State District Power Plant-2, citing lower costs as the reason for the switch from Russian turbines and generators, according to orda.kz.

incidents.title: Chinese-owned PetroKazakhstan Kumkol Resources to Pay Dividends
incidents.description: PetroKazakhstan Kumkol Resources, an oil company owned by China's PetroChina and KazMunayGaz, announced that it will pay $0.70 in dividends per share for 2024, according to Kursiv. The shareholders of PetroKazakhstan Inc. are CNPC E&D (67%; the financial statements indicate that the ultimate owner is PetroChina) and KazMunaiGas Exploration Production (33%, part of KazMunaiGaz).

incidents.title: Air China to Launch Flight Route to Kyrgyzstan's Capital
incidents.description: Kyrgyzstan and China have begun discussing the possibility of establishing regular air service between Beijing and Bishkek, which could include establishing an official Air China Limited representative office in the Kyrgyz capital as well as functioning partnerships between the Kyrgyz Asman airline and Air China, according to economist.kg.

incidents.title: China Requests a Visa-free Regime from Kyrgyzstan, Kyrgyzstan Reluctant
incidents.description: China is asking Kyrgyzstan to be the first to introduce a visa-free regime for Chinese citizens, but Kyrgyzstan prefers for the visa-free regimes to begin simultaneously between both nations, reports 24.kg. While citizens of Hong Kong can enter Kyrgyzstan under a pilot version of the regime, the principle of broader Chinese citizens entering under the same conditions is still being negotiated. When it comes to the U.S., Kyrgyzstan is also discussing reinstating the long-term five and ten-year visas for Kyrgyz citizens, showcasing competing priorities. The article gets pulled, China says they never demanded that.

incidents.title: "Turkmenistan–China: Women and Society" Roundtable
incidents.description: A roundtable discussion titled "Turkmenistan–China: Women and Society," organized by the Embassy of the People's Republic of China, was held at the Archabil Hotel in Ashgabat, during which women's role in the economic and cultural development of both nations was discussed, according to asmannews.ru in reference to the Orient news agency. The Chinese side, in turn, plans to invite 50,000 women to participate in training courses and launch 1,000 local social projects over the next five years.

incidents.title: Turkmenistan, Kazakhstan Discuss Chemical Industry Cooperation
incidents.description: Kazakhstan's Ambassador Nurlan Nogayev met Rusel Myradov, Chairman of the Turkmenhimiya State Concern to discuss ways to increase mutual trade and cooperation in chemical-industrial sector.

incidents.title: Uzbekistan Completes Ratification of Treaty Managing Shared Water Resources With Kazakhstan
incidents.description: Uzbekistan completed the ratification of the 15 November 2025 strategic partnership signed with Kazakhstan. This agreement establishes mechanisms for the joint management of transboundary water bodies.

incidents.title: Published List of Kazakhstani Citizens Recommended for Study in China
incidents.description: A list of Kazakh students seeking higher education was published, in which 102 out of 427 applicants were recommended for study in bachelor's, master's, and doctoral programs at leading universities in China. The final grant decisions will be made by the Chinese side, which will cover tuition fees, dormitory accommodation, health insurance, and monthly stipends.

incidents.title: China's Dongfang Electric to Facilitate Implementation of Renewable Energy Projects in Kyrgyzstan
incidents.description: Chakan Hydroelectric Power Plant OJSC and Dongfang Electric International Corporation (DEC) signed a Memorandum of Understanding geared toward introducing modern technologies in the renewable energy sector, according to economist.kg. DEC is already participating in the modernization of the Uch-Kurgan Hydroelectric Power Plant (HPP) and the second hydroelectric unit at the Kambar-Ata-2 HPP. This new stage of cooperation hopes to extend cooperation to the potential construction of solar and wind power plants.

incidents.title: International Youth Scientific Forum "Lomonosov–2026"
incidents.description: Higher education institutions in Turkmenistan will participate in the International Youth Scientific Forum "Lomonosov–2026," organized by Lomonosov Moscow State University, which will be attended by participants from Kazakhstan, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan, China, Russia, Armenia, and Azerbaijan, according to the official Turkmenistan government website.

incidents.title: Dushanbe Higher Ed Forum Ends with Scores of Agreements
incidents.description: At the Forum of Rectors of Higher Education Institutions of Uzbekistan and Tajikistan, universities signed 20 agreements to facilitate student and faculty exchange, scientific research, and other forums of higher ed cooperation.

incidents.title: Uzbekistan, Tajikistan Education Ministers Explore Future Cooperation
incidents.description: Uzbekistan Higher Education, Science and Innovation Minister, Kongratbay Sharipov traveled to meet his Tajikistan counterpart, Rahim Saidzoda. Discussions focused on facilitating cooperation in technology innovation (including AI), and boosting education cooperation. Uzbekistan also raised the issue of Uzbek language instruction in Tajikistan. No agreements were signed at this meeting

incidents.title: China Hosts Online Info Session to Attract University Students from Turkmenistan
incidents.description: With support of the Chinese Embassy, Turkmenistan will hold a large-scale online exhibition, “Study in China,” which will allow Turkmen applicants to attend 30-minute presentations from Chinese universities, delivered exclusively in Russian and covering topics ranging from scholarships, choosing in-demand majors, and campus living conditions. Specifically, six Chinese science flagship universities will be featured: Peking University, Shanghai Jiaotong University, Beijing Institute of Technology, along with leading universities in Harbin, Lanzhou, and Guizhou.

incidents.title: Kazakhstan Cultural Center in Beijing Hosts Opening Day Celebrations of Nauryznama
incidents.description: The Kazakhstan Cultural Center in Beijing hosted celebrations for Körüsu Künï, the opening day of the 10-day long celebration of Nauryznama. Included in the celebration was the exhibition and awards ceremony of the children's drawing competition "Nauryznama: Children of Kazakhstan and China Draw Friendship Together," reports Kazinform's Beijing correspondent.

incidents.title: Kazakh Government Approves Investment Agreement Between Ministry of Energy and Aktau Energy Company LLP for Turbine Construction
incidents.description: The Government of Kazakhstan approved the signing of an investment agreement between the Ministry of Energy of Kazakhstan and Aktau Energy Company LLP for the construction of a new 160-megawatt combined cycle gas turbine plant in Aktau, reports dknewz. Aktau Energy Company LLP was established jointly with the Chinese state-owned corporation China Huadian Corporation Ltd. In 2024. As a result, the Chinese investment company will finance 70 percent, while the Kazakh side will be responsible for the remaining 30 percent. The project provides for the creation of more than 300 jobs for Kazakhstani specialists, annual grants for master's degree studies in "Electric Power Engineering" at specialized universities in China, and the implementation of continuous training and professional development for industry employees.

incidents.title: Thirty-five Students to Study at One of China's Leading Agricultural Universities
incidents.description: Thirty-five students from Kozybayev University (Kazakhstan) went to study at Northwest Agriculture and Forestry University in Yangling, one of China's leading agricultural universities, according to Petropavlovsk.news. Upon completion of the program, which consists of six months of study in Petropavlovsk followed by continued studies and research in China, the students will receive two diplomas, one from Kazakhstan and one from China.

incidents.title: Land-based Trade Routes Through Central Asia Shorten Transport of Goods
incidents.description: Trains leaving from the Yangtze River Delta region in Eastern China arrived in Astana in about 9 days, which is about a third of the time of sea freight and is approximately five times cheaper than air freight, according to Kazakhstan Pravda.

incidents.title: Air China to Launch Flight between Bishkek and Beijing
incidents.description: In July 2026 the airline Air China will launch regular flights between Beijing and Bishkek that will operate three times weekly, as reported by the JSC "Airports of Kyrgyzstan.

incidents.title: President Tokayev Signs Agreement with China on Renewable Energy Projects
incidents.description: Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev signed a law ratifying an agreement between the governments of Kazakhstan and China on renewable energy projects in the Karaganda, Turkestan and Pavlodar regions. The projects are estimated $2.2 billion and Samruk-Energy will be a co-investor on the Kazakh side, reports interfax.

incidents.title: The National Leader of the Turkmen people and Chairman of the People's Council of Turkmenistan visit to China
incidents.description: The National Leader of the Turkmen people and Chairman of the People's Council of Turkmenistan arrived in China for a friendly visit at the invitation of the President of the People's Republic of China, Xi Jinping, according to the official Turkmenistan government website. Energy cooperation, the "One Belt, One Road" initiative, trade, and economics were highlighted, and China was emphasized as one of Turkmenistan's largest trading partners.

incidents.title: Desertification Prevention in Uzbekistan
incidents.description: The Governor of the Navoi Region announced that Uzbekistan's Navoi Region and the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region (NHAR) in northwestern China have the potential to develop cooperation in the fields of desertification prevention and control, soil restoration, agrobiotechnology, and resource-saving technologies after the delegations met in Ningxia Hui, reports Xinhua. The Navoi delegation also traveled to Fujian and met with Provincial Governor Zhao Long, who presented the region's implemented projects, economic potential, and opportunities, according to UzDaily.uz. Likewise, opportunities offered by the Navoi region Free Economic Zone were also presented, including tax incentives, streamlined land allocation procedures, and engineering infrastructure.

incidents.title: Representatives from Russian and Chinese Tourism Agencies to Visit Tajikistan for Navruz
incidents.description: An international delegation is arriving in Tajikistan for Navruz, comprising of representatives from the tourism agencies of Russia and China, executives from leading travel companies, renowned international travel bloggers, and representatives of authoritative foreign media outlets, reports Asia Plus.

incidents.title: China to Provide Over $59 million to Tajikistan for Construction of Transport Interchanges
incidents.description: China will provide over 410 million Chinese yuan ($59 million USD) to Tajikistan for the construction of four transport interchanges in Dushanbe, reports Avesta in reference to the Ministry of Finance of the Republic of Tajikistan. The construction of these transport interchanges is slated for the intersections of Abay and Qahhorov streets; Jami and Qahhorov streets; and the Southern Bypass Road and Qahhorov Street, as well as near the bridge spanning the Dushanbe River that connects Sohili and Qahhorov streets.

incidents.title: Energy and Trade Cooperation at the Forefront of Turkmen-Chinese Relations
incidents.description: In terms of energy cooperation, Xi Jinping urged for China and Turkmenistan to expand the scope of their cooperation in the natural gas sector, reports Xinhua. Areas such as connectivity, agriculture, artificial intelligence, the digital economy, and clean energy were also discussed.

incidents.title: "Galkynyş" Field Discussed at Meeting Between the National Leader of the Turkmen People and the China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC)
incidents.description: The National Leader of the Turkmen people and Chairman of the People's Council Halk Maslahaty Hero-Arkadag Gurbanguly Berdimuhamedov met with Dai Houliang, Chairman of the Board of Directors of the China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC), according to Turkmenistan Today. It was emphasized that the Turkmen-Chinese partnership in the oil and gas sector serves as a prime example of effective interstate relations. In this context, the importance of the agreements reached regarding the next phase of co-op developing the "Galkynyş" field was highlighted. At the conclusion of the meeting, the National Leader of the Turkmen people and the Chairman of the Board of Directors of the CNPC expressed their confidence in the continued successful development of mutually beneficial cooperation for the prosperity of the peoples of both countries.

incidents.title: Private Turkmen Business Helping Students with Secure International Study in China
incidents.description: "Ýönekeý," a private enterprise operating in three regions in Turkmenistan, helps Turkmen students secure educational opportunities abroad, including study in China, Turkey, and Malaysia, reports TurkmenPortal. Particular attention is given to programs in China, assisting with admissions to Chinese high schools and accepting students aged 9 to 16. For students 18 to 55, language prep courses are available, with annual tuition starting at 16,000–18,000 Turkmen manats. The company also helps with preparation for the CSCA exams, which are required for admission to Chinese universities.

incidents.title: The National Leader of the Turkmen People Visits the International Equestrian Complex “Equuleus" in China
incidents.description: The National Leader of the Turkmen people, Chairman of the Halk Maslahaty of Turkmenistan Hero-Arkadag, visited the International Equestrian Complex “Equuleus. On behalf of Turkmen President, who also holds the title as President of the International Akhal-Teke Horse Breeding Association, Serdar Berdimuhamedov, Hero-Arkadag invited the Chinese side to participate in the National Day of the Turkmen Horse, which will take place in April.

incidents.title: Turkmen President Signs Resolution Authorizing Contract with "CNPC Amudarya Petroleum Company Ltd."
incidents.description: Turkmengaz State Concern was authorized by the Turkmen President to sign a contract with CNPC Amudarya Petroleum Company Ltd. of the People's Republic of China, in which the company will aid in design and construction of a facility capable of producing 10 billion cubic meters of commercial gas per year. This will fall under the framework of the fourth stage of the "Galkynysh" gas field.

incidents.title: Joint Venture Established Between Kazakhstan's Atasu Group and Xinjiang International Land Port Group
incidents.description: Kazakhstan's Atasu Group, a transport and logistics group, established a joint venture, Xinjiang Eurasian Connect International Logistics Co., Ltd., with Xinjiang International Land Port Group, a key state-owned operator of China's international logistics sector, reports Forbes.kz. The venture will utilize the advantages of the Xinjiang Free Trade Zone to develop transport corridors between China, Central Asia, and Europe. The Chinese side's share in the joint venture will be 51%, and the Kazakh side's share will be 49%

incidents.title: Flight Route Launched Between Guangzhou and Bishkek
incidents.description: China Southern Airlines launched its first flight on the new international route between Guangzhou and Bishkek, reports 24.kg.

incidents.title: KazMunayGas and China National Petroleum Corporation Deepen Cooperation
incidents.description: KazMunayGas (KMG), Kazakhstan's national oil and gas company, and China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC) began a urea (carbamide) production project in the Aktobe Region. Total investment is estimated at $1.25 billion, reports Interfax. At present, Kazakhstan does not produce urea, and demand is met through imports.

incidents.title: China’s State Power Investment Corporation Facilitating 1 GW wind farm in Kazakhstan
incidents.description: China’s State Power Investment Corporation, in collaboration with Pavlodar Green Energy LLP, began construction of a 1 GW wind farm near the city of Ekibastuz in the Pavlodar region, as outlined under agreements signed with the Energy Ministry on January 29.Total investment is estimated at approximately $1.2 billion and, once operational, is expected to produce 3.4 billion kilowatt-hours of electricity annually and reduce carbon dioxide emissions by approximately 2 million tons per year, reports The Times of Central Asia

incidents.title: New Flight Route Launched Between Tashkent and Hangzhou
incidents.description: The launch of a new flight route connecting Tashkent and Hangzhou which is operated by the airline Qanot Shark, was held at Hangzhou Xiaoshan International Airport on March 31, reports Dunyo Information Agency.

incidents.title: Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan Foreign Ministers Discuss Further Cooperation
incidents.description: Uzbekistan and Kazakhstan's Foreign Ministers current issues affecting bilateral cooperation across a variety of areas, including trade, water, energy, and cultural cooperation. After talks, both signed a cooperation program to guide future negotiations in 2026-2027.

incidents.title: US Waiver Allows Kazakhstan to Continue Sending Russian Oil to China
incidents.description: The United States issued a waiver that will allow Kazakhstan to continue sending Russian oil to China through March 2027.

incidents.title: Kazakhstan-China Cross Year of Culture Begins
incidents.description: The Kazakhstan-China Cross Year of Culture commenced with a gala concert in Beijing, marking the launch of a large-scale cultural program, reports BAQ.kz. On the sidelines, a meeting was held between Prime Minister and Minister of Culture and Information of the Republic of Kazakhstan, Aida Balayeva, and Li Shulei, Head of the Propaganda Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, reports liter.kz. The two discussed developing future cultural products, emphasizing the film industry.

incidents.title: Potential Establishment of Joint Turkmen-Chinese Energy Training Center
incidents.description: A draft agreement for establishing a joint Turkmen-Chinese energy training center was discussed by representatives of the Yagshygeldi Kakayev International Oil and Gas University and the China University of Petroleum at an online working meeting. Specifically, legal information was updated from a 2024 draft agreement regulating educational and organizational matters.

incidents.title: Khorgos International Center for Cross-Border Cooperation Holds Cultural Event
incidents.description: A cross-cultural event was held on the Chinese side of the Khorgos International Center for Cross-Border Cooperation, reports kt.kz. During the opening ceremony, the Chinese media company "Maya" won first place for the international video competition "Khorgos Cup," which was aimed at promoting the region's tourism potential. A second international video competition, “Dialogue with Generation Z,” aimed at integrating the region’s youth, was announced.

incidents.title: Joint Education Facility Discussed by Representatives from the Chinese Academy of Railway Sciences and Lanzhou Jiaotong University During Bishkek Visit
incidents.description: The creation of a joint laboratory, implementation of digital technologies in logistics, and harmonization of technical standards was discussed by representatives from the Chinese Academy of Railway Sciences and Lanzhou Jiaotong University during a visit to Vocational School No. 97 in Bishkek. At the same time, Osh Technological University held a remote discussion with the Chinese automobile corporation Changan on the launch of new training programs in electric vehicle assembly and repair, involving the implementation of a "2+1+1" model, whereby students will study for two years at OshTU, one year at the Chongqing Vocational Institute in China, and then complete their studies at their home university.

incidents.title: Chinese Blogger Awarded by Kazakh Minister
incidents.description: A Chinese blogger and Kazakh Tourism Ambassador was awarded the Order of Dostyk, 2nd class, by Kazakhstan’s Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Culture, reports Novoetv.kz.

incidents.title: Cooperation in the Field of Medical Education between China and Tajikistan
incidents.description: Bilateral cooperation in the field of medicine, personnel training, and exchange of experience was discussed between the leadership of the Avicenna Tajik State Medical University and representatives of the People's Hospital of the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region of China in Dushanbe, reports Khovar, citing the Medical University. Willingness to develop bilateral cooperation in the field of medicine, training of highly qualified personnel, and exchange of experience was expressed. The importance of establishing mutually beneficial cooperation in the interests of both parties was emphasized.

incidents.title: Uzbek University Research Center opened at Tianjin Agricultural University
incidents.description: The Yangiyer Branch of the Tashkent Institute of Chemical Technology (TIC) Research Center opened at Tianjin Agricultural University, which will facilitate agriculture technology exchange between Uzbekistan and China, reports dknewz, citing Xinhua.

incidents.title: Opening Ceremony Held for the Kazakh-Chinese Center for Hydrogen Technologies
incidents.description: The opening ceremony for the Kazakh-Chinese Center for Hydrogen Technologies took place at Al-Farabi Kazakh National University and was attended by the Minister of Energy of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Mayor of Shanghai, the Minister of Science and Higher Education of the Republic of Kazakhstan, and the university’s Rector. The center was established following a a trilateral memorandum between Al-Farabi Kazakh National University, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, and Energy China International, that emphasized large-scale scientific and technical cooperation via joint research, testing hydrogen technologies, and launching experimental pilot projects, as well as academic exchange among specialists.

incidents.title: Decrease in Uzbekistanis Traveling Abroad for Education
incidents.description: In January and February of 2026, nearly 4,000 Uzbekistanis traveled abroad for educational purposes, out of which only 252 people traveled to China, while 989 people traveled to Russia, reports the National Statistics Committee. This is a 23.6% decrease compared to the same period last year.

incidents.title: Kazakhstan Seeks Water Resource Management Advice from China
incidents.description: Scientific and technological cooperation relating to water resources was discussed at a meeting held at Kazvodkhoz State Enterprise of the Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation, which was attended by Prime Minister of Kazakhstan Olzhas Bektenov, the National Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Kazakhstan under the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan, leading scientists from the Chinese Academy of Sciences and the Zhejiang University of Technology, and high-tech Chinese companies such as Tudou Data (i-Tudou), Liter.kz reports . Focus was on the DeepBas project as the basis for intelligent water resource management systems.

incidents.title: Kazakhstan Debuts Participation in the China International Education Exhibition Tour 2026
incidents.description: Vice Minister of Science and Higher Education of the Republic of Kazakhstan and representatives from 27 domestic higher education institutions took part in the China Study Abroad Forum and the China International Education Exhibition Tour 2026 (CIEET 2026), held in Beijing. Kazakhstan’s participation in CIEET 2026 marks its first appearance. The Vice Minister presented the current state and developments of the higher education system in Kazakhstan and the country had a national educational pavillion titled "Kazakhstan – the Territory of Academic Knowledge,” within which a joint "Study in Kazakhstan" exposition was presented. Also at the forum were representatives of educational institutions and specialized organizations from China, the USA, the UK, the Russian Federation, Australia, Singapore, Italy, Spain, Greece, Malaysia, Vietnam, amongst others.

incidents.title: Increase in Trains Sent Along the Xi'an Trans-Caspian China-Europe Freight Train Route During First Quarter of 2026
incidents.description: A total of 85 trains were sent along the Xi'an Trans-Caspian China-Europe freight train route in the first quarter of 2026, marking an increase of 150 percent year-on-year, reports Xinhua. Transit time has been reduced to 15 days from 20 since last year. The route connects Shanghai to Baku, with Almaty (Kazakhstan) serving as a key hub.

incidents.title: Enhanced Cooperation Between the Academy of Arts of Uzbekistan and the Chinese Academy of Arts
incidents.description: During a work visit to Shanghai, Chairman of the Academy of Arts of Uzbekistan and a delegation of artists signed a memorandum of cooperation with the China Academy of Arts, which provides participation of Uzbek and Chinese artists in creative projects, the organization of joint exhibitions, and the exchange of art education specialists, reports UZA.

incidents.title: Groundbreaking Scientific Internship - China to Share the Secrets of Science and Astrophysics
incidents.description: As part of efforts to strengthen international scientific cooperation and enhance the professional expertise of specialists, staff members from the Institute of Astrophysics of the National Academy of Sciences of Tajikistan are undertaking a scientific internship at the Xinjiang Astronomical Observatory of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, according to Khovar.

incidents.title: Working Group Formed for Construction on China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan Railway
incidents.description: Based on the instructions of the Deputy Chairman of the Uzbekistan Railways Joint-Stock Company, a working group consisting of qualified specialists has been formed to systematically and effectively organize construction work on the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway construction project, according to the telegram page of Uzbekistan Railways JSC.

incidents.title: International Forum of Rectors of Higher Education Institutions Held
incidents.description: Farhod Kodirzoda, a Tajikistan representative, participated in an event marking the 130th anniversary of Xi'an Jiaotong University, during which an international forum of Rectors of Higher Education Institutions from Central Asia and Europe was held, reports Khovar. Kodirzoda also participated in a meeting of the Cooperation Council of the "China–SCO–Central Asia" Higher Education Center, during which the Center's work plan for 2026–2027 was approved, and its future development prospects were outlined. Additionally, membership applications for the Council submitted by universities and research centers from SCO member states were accepted, and certificates were presented.

incidents.title: China Donates of Mobile Surgical Unit
incidents.description: A delegation from Uzbekistan, led by the heads of the Republican Specialized Scientific-Practical Medical Center of Cardiology and the Specialized Scientific-Practical Medical Center of Pediatrics, participated in a working visit to China, reports a correspondent for the "Dunyo" Information Agency. As part of the delegations visit, a meeting was held at the medical center of Fuwai Hospital, which resulted in an agreement being signed regarding the donation of a mobile surgical unit to the Republican Specialized Scientific-Practical Medical Center of Cardiology as humanitarian aid.

incidents.title: Kyrgyzstan Looks to China for Water Preservation
incidents.description: President Sadyr Japarov praised China’s experience with water preservation and irrigation while meeting with meeting with residents of the Alay district of the Osh region, reports Tazabek.

incidents.title: The Vice Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China Visits Turkmenistan
incidents.description: The Vice Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China is visiting Turkmenistan from April 15 to 17, according to Turkmen Portal, in reference to an announcement made by an official spokesperson for China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs. During this visit the Vice Premier met with the President of Turkmenistan and discussed the importance of continued cooperation and dialogue between the nations. The Vice Premier is also attending the groundbreaking ceremony for the fourth phase of the development of the Galkynysh gas field, reports Xinhua.

incidents.title: Funds Set Aside for ZENG Study-China Scholarship Grant and Scholarship Program
incidents.description: A ceremony was held to transfer an endowment fund from Chinese business representative Zeng Runhao to L.N. Gumilyov Eurasian National University following participation in the China International Education Exhibition Tour and the Study in Kazakhstan initiative, reports Liter.kz. The funds are set to implement the ZENG Study-China Scholarship grant and scholarship program, which is aimed at deepening cooperation in science and education between Kazakhstan and China.

incidents.title: Contract Signed to Deepen Geological Exploration Hydrocarbons at the Severny-1 subsoil Block in the Aktobe Region
incidents.description: A contract providing for 3.5 billion tenge in geological exploration activities and the production of hydrocarbons at the Severny-1 subsoil block in the Aktobe Region was signed between Deputy Minister of Energy Erlan Akbarov, Deputy Chairman of the Management Board of QazaqGaz Asylzhan Dauletov, and General Director of CNPC-Aktobemunaigas Zhu Shitao.

incidents.title: Kyrgyz Minister Discusses Kyrgyz-Chinese Cooperation in the Sphere of Education
incidents.description: Kyrgyzstan's Minister of Science, Higher Education, and Innovation Gulzat Isamatova discussed cooperation between Kyrgyzstan and China in the sphere of education during an interview with VB.kg. She noted that more than two and a half thousand Kyrgyz students are studying at Chinese universities and over 1,500 Chinese students are studying at universities in Kyrgyzstan. She also emphasized that long-term partnerships should be aimed at “expanding opportunities and strengthening Kyrgyzstan's intellectual sovereignty.”

incidents.title: Chinese Traditional Medicine Gaining Ground in Turkmenistan
incidents.description: A delegation from the Beijing University of Chinese Medicine visited the headquarters of the Gurbanguly Berdimuhamedov Charitable Foundation for Assistance to Children in Need of Guardianship and discussed expansions in healthcare as well as further integrating traditional Chinese, according to Turkmenistan's government portal.

incidents.title: Turkmen President Receives Chinese Diplomat for Seventh Meeting of the Turkmenistan-China Intergovernmental Cooperation Committee
incidents.description: President Serdar Berdimuhamedov received Ding Xuexiang, First Vice Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, for the seventh meeting of the Turkmenistan-China Intergovernmental Cooperation Committee, held in Ashgabat. The agenda covered trade, economic, and energy cooperation, with emphasis on the importance of advancing joint work on development of the Galkynysh field, the opening of the first Lu Ban Workshop and the first phase of the Center for Traditional Chinese Medicine.

incidents.title: Turkmen-Chinese MOU Signed to Develop AI and Technological Cooperation
incidents.description: A memorandum of understanding for the Ministry of Communications of Turkmenistan and the National Development and Reform Committee of the People's Republic of China on the development of cooperation in the field of artificial intelligence, scientific, technical and innovative cooperation for 2026–2028 between the Academy of Sciences of Turkmenistan and the Ministry of Science and Technology of the People’s Republic of China was signed during the seventh meeting of the Turkmenistan-China Intergovernmental Cooperation Committee.

incidents.title: Turkmen-Chinese MOU Signed to Establish Joint Energy Training Center
incidents.description: An agreement between the Yagshigeldi Kakayev International University of Oil and Gas (Turkmenistan), the Center for Chinese-Foreign Language Exchanges and Cooperation of the Ministry of Education of China (PRC) and the China University of Petroleum (Beijing, PRC) on the establishment of a joint Turkmen-Chinese energy training center was signed during the seventh meeting of the Turkmenistan-China Intergovernmental Cooperation Committee.

incidents.title: Turkmen-Chinese General Agreement Signed on Gas Cooperation
incidents.description: A general agreement between the Government of Turkmenistan and the Government of the People's Republic of China on the Basic Principles of Cooperation in the Gas Industry was signed during the seventh meeting of the Turkmenistan-China Intergovernmental Cooperation Committee.

incidents.title: Agreement to Speed Up Adoption of the New Economic Partnership Program Reached
incidents.description: Uzbekistan’s Minister of Investment, Industry, and Trade held talks with the Vice Minister of Commerce of the People's Republic of China, during which the parties discussed the implementation of agreements, as well as the further expansion of their bilateral partnership, reports UzDaily.uz. Moreover, an agreement was reached to accelerate the adoption of the New Economic Partnership Program and to advance initiatives within the framework of the "Digital Silk Road." The parties also emphasized the importance of preparations for upcoming international events, including a business forum in Hong Kong on May 6, the eighth meeting of the Intergovernmental Committee, and the Third Interregional Forum, which is scheduled to take place in Xi'an from May 20 to 22.

incidents.title: Agreements Reached for Establishment of a Joint Uzbek-Chinese Startup and Innovation Center
incidents.description: A delegation led by the Deputy Minister of Higher Education, Science, and Innovation, held an official meeting with the leadership of the "HICOOL" ecosystem in China, during which agreements were reached regarding the implementation of joint incubation and acceleration programs, the establishment of a joint Uzbek-Chinese startup and innovation center, and the creation of a specialized venture fund to support promising projects, reports uza.uz. At the conclusion of the meeting, the Chinese partners were invited to participate in "InnoWeek.Uz-2026."

incidents.title: Memorandum of Understanding Implementing Advanced Architecture and Engineering Solutions
incidents.description: A delegation from Uzbekistan, led by the Deputy Minister of Higher Education, Science, and Innovation, participated in the seventh meeting of the Sub-commission on Scientific and Technical Cooperation—held within the framework of the Uzbekistan–China Intergovernmental Commission in the PRC, according to UzDaily.uz. As a result of the meeting, a Memorandum of Understanding was signed, aimed at implementing advanced solutions in architecture and engineering, as well as developing mechanisms for technology transfer.

incidents.title: State of the Art Technological Agreement on International Scientific Cooperation Signed
incidents.description: The Beijing University of Chemical Technology and the Institute of New Materials and Energy Technologies (INMET) at Nazarbayev University have signed an agreement on international scientific cooperation, which will help develop joint innovative developments between Kazakhstan and China, reports DKNews.kz. Specific areas of collaboration are energy technologies, new materials, chemical engineering, artificial intelligence, and sustainable low-carbon technologies.

incidents.title: Chinese and Tajik Ministries of Education Discuss Cooperation Efforts
incidents.description: Deputy Minister of Education of Turkmenistan Azat Atayev led a meeting with the delegation of the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China, which included representatives of the Department of International Cooperation, the Department of Vocational and Higher Education, and the Center for Language Education and Cooperation of the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China.
