Talks focused on enhancing Turkmen-Chinese educational cooperation and the Chinese side noted that, since 2005, 44 Chinese language teachers have been sent to Turkmenistan, Chinese is taught in 10 schools in Turkmenistan, and about 6,200 students study it, with about 1,000 students study Chinese in 9 higher education institutions.

incidents.title: Gylkynysh Begins New Phase with CNPC Participation
incidents.description: China’s CNPC will construct a natural gas processing plant in Turkmenistan with an annual capacity of 10 billion cubic meters and will be located at the Galkynysh gas field, according to the Caspian Herald, in reference to a government announcement. The new facility will help Beijing further diversify its energy sources and bolster its energy security. The start date for construction and the total investment cost have not yet been disclosed.

incidents.title: China's CNPC XIBU Drilling Engineering Company Signs Deal with Uzbekistan to Further Drilling Exploration
incidents.description: Uzbekneftegaz, Uzbekistan’s state energy company, signed a contract with China’s CNPC XIBU Drilling Engineering Company Limited to drill 30 exploration wells in the Ustyurt region from 2026-2028, reports UZDaily.

incidents.title: "Smart Port" Systems Along the Xinjiang–Kazakhstan Border Proving Successful
incidents.description: The digitalization of border crossings and the implementation of "smart port" systems along the Xinjiang–Kazakhstan border have radically accelerated the transit of perishable goods; customs clearance time for agricultural exports has been reduced from five days to 24 hours, reports Kazakhstan Today in reference to an announcement made by a representative of the Xinjiang branch of China News Service.

incidents.title: Power Equipment for Ekibastuz State District Power Plant-2 in Limbo
incidents.description: The use of power equipment, previously purchased from China and designated the modernization of Ekibastuz State District Power Plant-2 (units No. 3 and No. 4), is in limbo due to a legal dispute with the supplier, Harbin Electric International, regarding plans for its use in the construction of Ekibastuz GRES-3, reports Kursiv, citing the Managing Director of Procurement and Risk at Samruk-Energy. Kazakhstan previously abandoned the purchase of Russian turbines and generators for the third power unit of GRES-2 and switched to Chinese suppliers, saving up to 250 billion tenge.

incidents.title: Tajikistan Looks Toward China for Lessons in Poverty Reduction
incidents.description: A training seminar aimed at poverty eradication was held as part of the Central Executive Committee of the People's Democratic Party of Tajikistan’s (NDPT) visit to China, reports the Tajikistan National News Agency, Khovar.

incidents.title: Russian, Central Asian Industrial Ministers Meet at Tashkent Forum
incidents.description: The industrial ministers (or their equivalent) of Russia and Central Asia met in a dialogue hosted by Uzbekistan. While no agreements were signed at this meeting, ministers discussed various proposals to increase industrial cooperation, including launching a program to train at least 10,000 specialists in industrial management.

incidents.title: Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, and Afghanistan Discuss Trade
incidents.description: Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, and Afghanistan's trade ministers get to discuss avenues for future economic cooperation, with a particular emphasis on expanding cross-border transport routes. No agreements were signed.

incidents.title: Sichuan Yinhe Chemical Co., Ltd. is Considering Building a Deep Chrome Processing Plant in Kazakhstan
incidents.description: Sichuan Yinhe Chemical Co., Ltd. is considering building a deep chrome processing plant in the Aktobe Region, according to the Kazakh government portal. The Regional Governor discussed prospects for building the deep chrome processing plant with the Executive Director of the company and Sichuan Yinhe Chemical Co., Ltd. reportedly intends to invest 500 million USD in the construction for this project. Following the meeting, the parties reaffirmed their mutual interest in implementing the project and expressed confidence that this collaboration would serve as a significant step toward strengthening Kazakhstani-Chinese economic ties and further developing the industrial potential of the Aktobe region.

incidents.title: China-Kyrgyz Assessment of Border Crossing Points
incidents.description: From April 13 to 17, officials from the State Customs Service of Kyrgyzstan, together with their counterparts from the customs authorities of the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region of China, conducted an on-site assessment of the border crossing points between the two countries, according to open.kg. As a result of the meetings, key agreements were reached, including increasing the number of liaison officers, improving mechanisms for responding to vehicle congestion at border crossings, and enhancing cooperation and information exchange. Furthermore, the Kyrgyz side once again proposed the possibility of transitioning the Torugart border crossing point to a 24-hour operational schedule on the Chinese side.

incidents.title: Al-Farabi Kazakh National University Creates Working Groups
incidents.description: Al-Farabi Kazakh National University hosted discussions between the Chairman of the Board and Rector of KazNU—and a delegation from the Chinese company Danacoid regarding the establishment of a modern digital campus, according to DKNews.kz. Following the negotiations, the meeting participants agreed on the formation of a joint working group.

incidents.title: Tajikistan Proposes Central Asian Energy Commission
incidents.description: Tajikistan President Emomali Rahmon proposed that Central Asian states established a joint energy commission to manage regional energy cooperation, with a goal to increase energy saving and water conservation.

incidents.title: International Chinese Poetry Festival Held in Tashkent
incidents.description: The International Chinese poetry festival and performance "Poetry Connects the World" was held in Tashkent, which showcased an exhibition of Chinese character art designs, reports Xinhua. Approximately 300 people from the Chinese Embassy in Uzbekistan, as well as representatives from the educational, cultural, and artistic communities of both countries, participated, including Xue Lian, Counselor of the Chinese Embassy in Uzbekistan.

incidents.title: SCO Transport Minister Meeting Occurs in Bishkek
incidents.description: Bishkek hosted a meeting of Shanghai Cooperation Organization transported ministers. They discussed challenges to cross border transportation and signed a memorandum of understanding that committed states to examine how the digitization of permits could facilitate cross border trade.

incidents.title: Chinese Company and Tajikistan Discuss Water Supply and Sanitation
incidents.description: Water supply and the sanitation sector were discussed at a meeting between the State Unitary Enterprise Dushanbe Vodokanal and a delegation from the Chinese company Shanghai Municipal Engineering Design Institute (Group) Co., Ltd. Specifically, modernization and reconstruction of sewage pumping stations, increasing the efficiency of drinking water supply stations, replacing worn-out pipelines, reducing water losses, and introducing modern equipment and technologies were discussed.

incidents.title: Turkic Transport Ministers Meet
incidents.description: The Organization of Turkic States convened a meeting of transport ministers from member states in Bishkek. Discussed was various proposals to facilitate unhindered movement of goods at borders, including how to integrate digital technologies to do so. At the end of the meeting, a joint communique was adopted that committed states to further examining how to ease transportation.

incidents.title: China Petroleum Engineering Announces $4.6 billion Contract
incidents.description: The Chinese company China Petroleum Engineering has announced a $4.6 billion contract to construct oil and gas production infrastructure at the Galkynysh gas field in Turkmenistan, which is part of a broader agreement with its parent company, CNPC, and the Turkmen state corporation "Turkmengaz", reports oilcapital.ru. Construction is scheduled to commence in 2026 and be completed within 51 months.

incidents.title: "Kazakhstan and China: Rapprochement of Cultures on the Silk Road" Event Held in Kazakhstan
incidents.description: An event, "Kazakhstan and China: Rapprochement of Cultures on the Silk Road," was held at the Alatau Creative Hub in Almaty, reports DKNews.kz. The Laoshi Educational Center, the Belt and Road Scientific and Educational Center, the Department of Language and General Education for Foreigners of the Faculty of Pre-University Education at Al-Farabi Kazakh National University, and the Alatau Creative Hub, participated in the organization.

incidents.title: "Zhetysu" Terminal Project Inspected by Kazakh Minister
incidents.description: The Ministry of Transport of the Republic of Kazakhstan inspected key transit and logistics projects in Almaty, including the "Zhetysu" terminal, which is being developed by the joint venture Kazakh-Chinese Trade and Logistics Company (Almaty) Ltd., with the participation of Kedentransservice JSC and the Xi’an Free Trade Port.

incidents.title: 85,000 Vehicles Exported Through the Khorgos Checkpoint in China's Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region
incidents.description: 85,000 vehicles were exported through the Khorgos checkpoint in China's Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region in the first quarter of 2026, which represents a 13.1% increase compared to the same period in the previous year, reports Exclusive.kz, according to data from the Khorgos Customs Office.

incidents.title: Kyrgyzstan and the Chinese company POWERCHINA Discuss Joint Investment Projects
incidents.description: Kyrgyzstan and the Chinese company POWERCHINA discussed joint investment projects in energy and infrastructure during a meeting between the Head of the National Investment Agency and a delegation from POWERCHINA, reports vb.kg.

incidents.title: Kyrgyzstan Tests Road Route through China to Pakistan
incidents.description: The first truck from Kyrgyzstan entered Pakistan via China under the Quadrilateral Traffic in Transit Agreement, reports 24.kg, citing the Kyrgyz Ministry of Transport and Communications. The route initiates in Bishkek before passing through the Torugart border crossing, then along the Kashgar — Khunjerab — Islamabad route to Karachi, a seaport in Pakistan.

incidents.title: Chairman of the Sughd Region Meets with the head of "Silk Road" LLC
incidents.description: The Chairman of the Sughd Region held a meeting with the head of "Silk Road" LLC and Director of the international organization "Voice of Asia", according to Avesta.tj in reference to the press service of the Regional Chairman. Following the meeting, both parties expressed their readiness to further expand cooperation in the spheres of science and education, as well as to integrate innovative technologies into agricultural development.

incidents.title: Chinese Share Expertise in Early Warning Systems for Dust and Sandstorms
incidents.description: On the sidelines of the Regional Environmental Summit, a meeting took place between the Advisor to the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan on Ecology and the Minister of Ecology and Environment of the PRC, during which the parties discussed the current state and future prospects of Uzbek Chinese cooperation in the field of environmental protection, according to the National Environmental and Climate Change Committee. Following the meeting, an agreement was reached to leverage advanced Chinese expertise in strengthening early warning systems for dust and sandstorms, with a view to subsequently adapting these mechanisms for use in Uzbekistan.

incidents.title: Joint Undergraduate Programs in the fields of Vehicle Engineering Considered
incidents.description: During an official visit by a delegation from the Tashkent State Transport University to the People's Republic of China, a meeting was held in the city of Shenzhen with the leadership of Shenzhen Polytechnic University, according to the Ministry of Transportation of Uzbekistan. Following the negotiations, an agreement was signed aimed to launch joint undergraduate educational programs in the fields of "Vehicle Engineering (New Energy Vehicles)" and "Aviation Engineering"—specifically, in the domain of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs).

incidents.title: Chengdu Airlines Launches Weekly Flights Between Osh and Kashgar
incidents.description: Chengdu Airlines launched weekly flights between Osh and Kashgar, reports open.kg.

incidents.title: China Donates Equipment to Kyrgyz Vocational Schools
incidents.description: China donated equipment to vocational schools, reports open.kg. The donation related to the opening of the Center for the Development of Professional Education in Central Asia and was conducted by the Director of the Overseas Business Department for Central Asia of the Wuhan Central Group for Foreign Economic and Technical Cooperation.

incidents.title: Renewable Energy Cooperation Discussed between the Head of the National Agency for Investments and a Delegation from the China Energy Engineering Investment Company
incidents.description: Renewable energy cooperation was discussed between the Head of the National Agency for Investments and a delegation from the China Energy Engineering Investment Company, reports Tazabek, citing the agency's press service. While no outcome was reached, the Chinese side expressed interest investing up to $1 billion for construction of solar and wind power plants with a total capacity of up to 700 MW.

incidents.title: A Memorandum of Scientific Cooperation Signed Between Southwest University (China) and the Institute of Botany, Plant Physiology, and Genetics of the National Academy of Sciences of Tajikistan
incidents.description: Achievements in the genetics and breeding of agricultural crops in Tajikistan were discussed at an international scientific conference dedicated to the 120th anniversary of the founding of Southwest University (People's Republic of China), held in the Beibei District of Chongqing Province, China, reports Khovar. During the conference a Memorandum of Scientific Cooperation was signed between Southwest University (China) and the Institute of Botany, Plant Physiology, and Genetics of the National Academy of Sciences of Tajikistan.

incidents.title: Flights to Resume Between Astana and Urumqi
incidents.description: Direct flights will resume on the Astana-Urumqi-Astana route as announced by FlyArystan Airlines and reported by DKNews.kz. According to the airline’s CEO, the return of this route is a direct result of cooperation between the Kazakh and Chinese governments.

incidents.title: Turkmenistan Interested in Expanding Cooperation with China in High Technology
incidents.description: Turkmenistan is interested in expanding cooperation with China in the field of high technologies, including the establishment of artificial intelligence research centers, reports Turkmenportal in reference to an announcement made by Turkmenistan’s Minister of Communications while speaking at a Turkmen Chinese forum in Ashgabat.

incidents.title: Construction Begins on 500 MW Wind farm in the Karaganda Region
incidents.description: Kazakhstan's Samruk-Energo, in partnership with China Energy International Group, began construction on a 500 MW wind farm in the Karaganda region. The wind farm is scheduled to be commissioned in the first quarter of 2029, total investment in the project is $645 million, and annual electricity generation is expected to be approximately 1.60 billion kWh.

incidents.title: JSC NC Kazakhstan Temir Zholy Establishing Maritime Fleet
incidents.description: In fulfillment of the directives issued by the Head of State, JSC NC Kazakhstan Temir Zholy establishing its own maritime fleet to further develop the Trans-Caspian International Transport Route (TITR), according to press Service, JSC NC Kazakhstan Temir Zholy. KTZ Express’s subsidiary, KTZ Express Shipping LLP, has signed contracts for the construction of six multi-purpose dry cargo vessels/container carriers. Agreements have been concluded with Jiangsu Haizhongzhou Shipping Industry Co., Ltd. for the construction of four vessels, and with the Baku Shipyard for the construction of two additional vessels.

incidents.title: Hydro and Solar Projects to be Launched in Kyrgyzstan with Chinese Help
incidents.description: An opening ceremony marked the beginning of work on a complex combining hydropower and solar energy in Jalal-Abad, facilitated by the Chinese company SINOMACH, reports check.point.kg.

incidents.title: Turkmenistan Holds Negotiations with Chinese Technology Companies
incidents.description: Expanding Turkmen-Chinese cooperation in high technology, including AI, was discussed between Ministry of Communications of Turkmenistan and representatives of Huawei Technologies Co., LTD, FE ZTE INVESTMENT LLC, Shanghai DTSpace Futech Auto Tech Co., Xinjiang Poplar Cable Manufacturing Co., Ltd., and China Information and Communication Technologies Group Corporation, reports TurkmenPortal.

incidents.title: Flight Route Launched Between Guangzhou and Tashkent
incidents.description: Uzbekistan Airways will launch regular flights to Guangzhou staring May 27, marking the airline’s sixth destination in China, reports UzDaily.

incidents.title: Turkmen Diplomats Participate in Cycling Event in Beijing
incidents.description: Diplomats from the Embassy of Turkmenistan in China, as well as Turkmen and Chinese youth, took part in a cycling event with the motto “Friendship between Turkmenistan and China: Low-Carbon Health and a Youthful Spirit,” held in Beijing, reports BigAsia.ru.

incidents.title: Inaugural flight on the Kashgar–Osh Route
incidents.description: On April 28, the inaugural flight on the Kashgar–Osh route took place, with the aircraft departing from Laining Airport and landing in Osh, thereby launching regular air service between the two cities, reports open.kg.

incidents.title: Turkmen Pedagogical Institute Working Visit to China
incidents.description: Representatives of the Seyitnazar Seydi Turkmen State Pedagogical Institute visited Shandong Normal University, Beijing Normal University, and several companies during a working visit to the People's Republic of China from April 23 to May 2.

incidents.title: Multimodal Route Delivering cargo from China to Afghanistan Launched
incidents.description: A multimodal route delivering cargo from China to Afghanistan has been launched. Cargo initially enters Uzbekistan from China via the Altinkol station in Kazakhstan and are delivered to the Bukhara logistics center of “Uztemiryo'lkonteyner” JSC, reports O’ztemiryo’lkonteyner.

incidents.title: Uzbekistan and Tajikistan Discuss Implementation of Digital Certification of Goods
incidents.description: Representatives of Uzbekistan and Tajikistan discussed the implementation of digital certificates of goods produced in each other's countries.

incidents.title: Transport Vehicles at Border Area Near "Khorgos" Catch Fire
incidents.description: A fire engulfed approximately a dozen transport vehicles at border area near the "Khorgos" International Center for Boundary Cooperation (ICBC), destroying the vehicles and the Chinese goods they were transporting, according to Orda.kz. Chinese authorities have not yet officially disclosed the extent of the damage or the contents of the trucks.

incidents.title: Many Agreements Signed at the China-Uzbekistan Business Forum
incidents.description: 15 bilateral agreements aimed at expanding cooperation in energy, agriculture, and mining were signed at the China-Uzbekistan business forum in Hong Kong, reports UzDaily, citing the Chinese television network CCTV. Among the agreements are: large-scale agricultural and investment projects worth over $550 million, a 150 MW energy storage system in the Samarkand region, export agreements worth approximately $2 million. Leadership from the Fergana Region met with the head of the Chinese company Ecopioneer Storage Hk Science & Technology Limited, as well as with Shaoxing Shaxue Daily Chemical Products Co., Ltd. and founder of LULIN LLC, to discuss a potential $10 million investment project to create a production facility for hygiene products in Fergana.

incidents.title: Chinese Petrochemical Company Proposes a Large-scale Gas Processing Plant
incidents.description: The Chinese petrochemical company Puyang Shengyuan has put forward an initiative to implement a large-scale gas processing project in Turkmenistan, according to Vestibad.ru, in reference to Nebit-Gaz. The project envisions the construction of a methanol production plant with an annual capacity of 1.8 million tons.

incidents.title: Central Asian Universities Sign MOU
incidents.description: MOU expands university to university collaboration in research, and student/faculty exchange.

incidents.title: China’s Deputy Minister of Culture Visits Kyrgyzstan’s National History Museum
incidents.description: China’s Deputy Minister of Culture visited Kyrgyzstan’s National History Museum, reports Open.kg.

incidents.title: Contracts Totaling $8 billion Signed between China and Tajikistan
incidents.description: During Emomali Rahmon’s visit to China, Chinese and Tajikistani companies signed contracts worth over $8 billion in Beijing, reports avesta.tj in reference to an announced by the Press Service of the President of Tajikistan. The Tajik head of state noted that more than 700 Chinese companies have already invested in Tajikistan’s economy and highlighted the favorable geographic location of Tajikistan regarding investment opportunities. The Head of China Pingmei Shenma Energy Chemical Group also noted that they are planning to launch a new production line for coal processing, with a projected investment volume of $300 million.

incidents.title: Agro-industrial Cooperation Deal Inked Between Kazakhstan and Tajikistan
incidents.description: Kazakhstan and Tajikistan will sign a roadmap for future cooperation in the agro-industrial sector. This comes amidst a 26% surge in agro-industrial trade between these states

incidents.title: Templewater Investment Firm Meets with the Chairman of the Tourism Committee of the Republic of Uzbekistan
incidents.description: The Chairman of the Tourism Committee of the Republic of Uzbekistan held a meeting with the head of the investment firm Templewater, during which the parties discussed the prospects for investment projects in the fields of tourism, hospitality, energy, and AI, according to UzDaily.uz. Concluding the negotiations, both parties reaffirmed their interest in attracting investment into the tourism accommodation sector, develop hotel infrastructure, and promote Uzbekistan on the international tourism market.

incidents.title: China and Uzbekistan Sign 31 New Cooperation Documents
incidents.description: The President of Tajikistan Emomali Rahmon arrived in China for an official visit and high-level meetings, following which 31 new cooperation documents were signed between Tajikistan and China, according to the Press Service of the President of Tajikistan. Notably, the heads of state signed a Joint Statement of the Republic of Tajikistan and the People's Republic of China on Deepening Comprehensive Cooperation and Strategic Partnership in a New Era, as well as a Treaty on Eternal Friendship, Good-Neighborliness, and Cooperation between the Republic of Tajikistan and the People's Republic of China.

incidents.title: Aktau Energy Company LLP Signs Loan Agreements with a Syndicate of Chinese Banks
incidents.description: In Beijing, Aktau Energy Company LLP signed loan agreements with a syndicate of Chinese banks, which will allocate funds toward the construction of a 160 MW combined-cycle power plant in the city of Aktau, according to zhaik.su. The financing is being provided by the China Development Bank, the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, and its branch in Almaty which will cover up to 70% of the project's total 1.5-billion-yuan cost. The bank loan amounts to 1.05 billion yuan, while the additional contributions from participants of the company's authorized capital amount to 450 million yuan. The strategic investor in this project is the China Huadian Corporation, which had signed an investment agreement outlining specific support measures with the Ministry of Energy of the Republic of Kazakhstan earlier this year.

incidents.title: Investment Projects Discussed between the Kazakh Minister of Energy and East Hope Group
incidents.description: Implementation of investment projects in the Kostanay region were discussed between the Kazakh Minister of Energy and a representative from East Hope Group, reports Inform.kz, citing the Ministry’s press service. Specifically noted was the potential for a 1 GW coal-fired power plant to power a future aluminum production complex, which was discussed between East Hope Group and Kazakh Minister of Industry. The complex will create a full-cycle aluminum cluster, spanning from bauxite mining to primary aluminum production, and is currently being surveyed in Kostanay and Aktobe, with investment estimated to be $12.6 billion.

incidents.title: Discussions to Increase Throughput at the Torugart and Irkeshtam checkpoints on the Kyrgyzstan-China Border
incidents.description: Increasing throughput at the Torugart and Irkeshtam checkpoints on the Kyrgyzstan-China border and creation of a cargo terminal at Osh Airport was discussed between Kyrgyzstan’s Ministry of Water Resources, Agriculture, and Processing Industry, held a videoconference with the Chairman of the People's Government of the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region of China, reports Open.kg.

incidents.title: Joint Action Plan for Cooperation on Poverty Reduction Signed Between China and Uzbekistan
incidents.description: During the eighth meeting of the Uzbekistan–China Intergovernmental Committee, negotiations were held between the Ministry of Poverty Reduction and Employment of Uzbekistan and the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs of the People's Republic of China, following which the parties signed a Joint Action Plan for Cooperation on Poverty Reduction for the years 2026–2027, according to Uz.Daily.uz. Furthermore, the parties agreed upon several practical initiatives, including the signing of a memorandum of cooperation between the Institute for Poverty and Labor Market Research and the International Poverty Reduction Center in China, as well as the establishment of a Technology Transfer Center in Uzbekistan. The parties also approved plans to develop a roadmap for the implementation of the Joint Action Plan, which is scheduled to be presented at a high-level forum in Beijing in May 2026. Additionally, plans were made to hold an Uzbekistan–China Forum on Poverty Reduction in the Syrdarya region in October 2026.

incidents.title: Kazakhstan Adopting China's Experience in Water Management
incidents.description: 34 Kazakhstani water management specialists traveled to China to participate in a training seminar on water resource management and aquatic environment improvement technologies, reports DKnews. China covered all expenses, and it is estimated that 200 specialists will be trained by the end of 2026.

incidents.title: China and Kyrgyzstan Discuss Facilitating Construction on the Barskoon–Uchturfan–Aksu Highway
incidents.description: The Deputy Chairman of the Cabinet of Ministers of the Kyrgyz Republic and the Minister of Water Resources, Agriculture, and Processing Industry held negotiations via video conference with the Chairman of the People's Government of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region (XUAR) of the PRC, reports eltr.kg. The parties discussed methods of increasing the throughput capacity of the Torugart and Irkeshtam border crossing points, as well as establishing a temporary road to facilitate entry of specialized machinery, construction equipment, and other cargo intended into Kyrgyzstan for the construction of the Barskoon–Uchturfan–Aksu highway.

incidents.title: Rector of the Y. Kakayev International University of Oil and Gas Visit to China
incidents.description: Rector of the Yagshygeldi Kakayev International University of Oil and Gas participated in the symposium organized by the China University of Petroleum in Beijing. Talks centered on further development of the Luban Workshop in Turkmenistan.

incidents.title: Launch of Astana LRT System
incidents.description: President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev officially launched the Astana LRT system and inspected the operations of the Unified Dispatch Center, which will monitor and regulate the capital's public transport, including the LRT system, according to Liter.kz. The LRT infrastructure comprises 18 stations, including a modern depot, and is built with Chinese technology, equipment and standards.

incidents.title: Bishkek Mayor Discusses Water Management with Chinese Investors
incidents.description: The Mayor of Bishkek met with Chinese investors led by the Vice President of the China State Construction Engineering Corporation and Chairman of the Board of the China Construction Fifth Engineering Division Corp, according to 24.kg. A memorandum establishing friendly relations between the capital's Mayor's Office and the China Construction Fifth Engineering Division Corp. was signed during the meeting. The parties also expressed their intention to establish a partnership aimed at modernizing Bishkek municipal water supply system, as well as constructing two wastewater treatment plants.

incidents.title: China and Tajikistan Sign an Memorandum of Understanding for Television and Radio Broadcasting
incidents.description: A Memorandum of Understanding with the goal of deepening television and radio broadcasting cooperation was signed between the Committee on Television and Radio Broadcasting under the Government of the Republic of Tajikistan and the China Media Corporation during President Rahmon’s visit to China.

incidents.title: Uzbekistan Participates in Economic, Scientific, Technical, and Cultural Cooperation and Exchanges between Shanghai and the Belt and Road Regions
incidents.description: Staff from the Consulate General in Shanghai presented on opportunities for cooperation in tourism, green energy, IT, textiles, agriculture, logistics, and pharmaceuticals in Uzbekistan as part of the "Economic, Scientific, Technical, and Cultural Cooperation and Exchanges between Shanghai and the Belt and Road Regions" conference, reports Dunyo.info. Agreements were reached to send delegations to Uzbekistan.

incidents.title: China's Embassy in Kazakhstan Organizes Event for Children with Special Needs
incidents.description: The Embassy of the PRC in Kazakhstan, in collaboration with the Baquitty Shangyraq charitable foundation, organized a festive event for children with special needs, during which the children presented creative performances and the Embassy donated gifts worth 700,000 tenge, including backpacks, toys, and essential school supplies, according to dknews.kz

incidents.title: Repairs on the Kuyuk Pass Completed
incidents.description: Major repairs have been completed on an 11-kilometer section of the Kuyuk Pass and an official opening of traffic ceremony took place in the Zhambyl region, reports Bizmedia.kz.

incidents.title: Khorgos to Endure Large-scale Overhaul
incidents.description: The Government of Kazakhstan is preparing a large-scale overhaul of border infrastructure along its frontier with China, particularly the Khorgos site, according to Exclusive.kz. Alongside four temporary warehouse sites being opened and Khorgos ICBC shifting to 24/7 Operations, authorized government bodies and major corporations in the PRC are negotiating to establish an unimpeded transport corridor linking Kazakhstan’s Khorgos – Eastern Gates Special Economic Zone (SEZ) with China’s Khorgos SEZ.

incidents.title: 214 Residential Homes to be Demolished During China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan Railway Construction
incidents.description: Due to the construction of a new railway in Kyrgyzstan, 214 residential homes will be demolished, 191 of which are located in the Suzak District of the Jalal-Abad Region and the remaining located in the Naryn Region, according to 24.kg. The final property value assessment has been submitted to the Cabinet of Ministers for review, and the compensation payout process is currently underway, yet full support for the project from affected residents has not been achieved.

incidents.title: Additional $305 Million Loan Agreement for China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan Railway Reviewed by the Jogorku Kenesh
incidents.description: The Jogorku Kenesh Committee on Industrial Policy, Transport, the Fuel and Energy Complex, Architecture and Construction reviewed a draft of the additional funding agreement pertaining to the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway, where China will provide Kyrgyzstan with a loan of $305 million, according to kaktus.media. The loan is set for a term of 25 years and covers 12.25% out of the 25% that Kyrgyzstan agreed to fund for the project.

incidents.title: Uzbekistan Agency for Youth Affairs Participates in Cultural and Training Courses
incidents.description: A delegation from the Uzbekistan Agency for Youth Affairs participated in training courses on artificial intelligence, calligraphy lessons, and sports and cultural events in Guangzhou and Shenzhen, reports a Dunyo.info.

incidents.title: Uzbekistan Supports China's "One China" Policy
incidents.description: Development of joint infrastructure projects, expansion of mutual trade and investment, strengthening regional connectivity, cooperation in high technology, agriculture, security, and poverty reduction was discussed at a meeting between Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Uzbekistan and China’s Ambassador to Uzbekistan, reports Uzbekistan’s official government-run national news agency, citing the Foreign Ministry's press service. The Uzbek side noted its support for China’s “One China” policy.

incidents.title: Trilateral Meeting Discusses Future of Green Energy Cooperation
incidents.description: Representatives from Kazakhstan, Azerbaijan, and Uzbekistan met to discuss the implementation of the Green Corridor Alliance project and how to further the use of renewable energy in Central Asia.

incidents.title: The Russia-Kazakhstan-China Oil Pipeline Agreement Enters Formalization Phase
incidents.description: An agreement to increase the transit of Russian oil to China via Kazakhstan from 10 million to 12.5 million tons per year is now being legally formalized, reports Interfax as well as Petrocouncil.kz. Though Russia Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak says that the agreement was reached some time ago, the legal formalization process is only now underway. The transportation of Russian oil to China will be done through the Atasu–Alashankou oil pipeline.

incidents.title: Air Astana Increases flights to China in 2026
incidents.description: In Q1 2026 Air Astana increased Chinese route capacity by 117% and now intends to operate 50 flights per week to China, up from 23 flights earlier this year, according to BAQ.KZ correspondent.

incidents.title: The Institute of Astrophysics of the National Academy of Sciences of Tajikistan Participates in the International Astronomical Union in Hong Kong
incidents.description: A representative of the Institute of Astrophysics of the National Academy of Sciences of Tajikistan participated in the regional meeting of the International Astronomical Union in the Asia-Pacific region, "APRIM-2026," in Hong Kong, China, from May 2-10, reports Khovar, citing the National Academy of Sciences of Tajikistan.

incidents.title: Tajikistan Shares Experience at the International Forum on Public Administration in China
incidents.description: Specialists from the Tajik State University of Law, Business, and Politics participated in the International Forum "Public Administration and Sustainable Development: Dialogue between China and Central Asia," held in the People's Republic of China, reports Khovar, citing the university. An agreement to strengthen cooperation, organize joint educational programs, and develop academic exchange in 2026 was reached during meetings with leadership from Faculty of Law of Lanzhou University.

incidents.title: Turkmenistan Supports China's "One China" Policy
incidents.description: Turkmenistan’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs issued a formal position in support of China’s “One China” policy, which maintains that the Government of the People's Republic of China is the sole legitimate government representing all of China, including Taiwan.

incidents.title: $430 Million Energy and Logistics Project Launched Between OJSC Kyrgyzkomur and Xinjiang Dacheng Yuanlong Technology Co., Ltd.
incidents.description: OJSC Kyrgyzkomur and Chinese company Xinjiang Dacheng Yuanlong Technology Co., Ltd. are launching a $430 Million energy and logistics project, which will encompass a logistics center, a conveyor system and two coal preparation plants, reports open.kg as well as Akchabar. Moreover, a time capsule laying ceremony was held in the village of Nura, Alay District, Osh Region, marking projects launch and the event was attended by Kyrgyzstan’s Deputy Minister of Energy.

incidents.title: Message from Turkmen President to Xi Jinping
incidents.description: President Xi Jinping sent a message to the President of Turkmenistan following an invitation to visit Turkmenistan. In the message, which was published on Turkmenistan’s official state-owned news agency, the Chinese president accepted the invitation and emphasized deepening cooperation between the two countries.

incidents.title: Eurasmus Program Facilitates Central Asian Collaboration on AI in Higher ED
incidents.description: Researchers, university staff, and officials from Central Asian education ministries met in Astana to exchange best practices for the integration of AI in education and to discuss future education cooperation between Central Asian states.

incidents.title: Two Coal Enrichment Plants to be Built in Kyrgyzstan
incidents.description: А logistics center with two coal enrichment plants worth $430 million will be built in Kyrgyzstan’s Alay district as part of cooperation between OJSC "Kyrgyzkomur" and the Chinese company Xinjiang Dacheng Yuanlong Technology Co., Ltd., reports Vesti.kg. The goal of the project is to establish coal exports from the Tekelik deposit through the "Irkeshtam" checkpoint, which will reduce transport costs.

incidents.title: Central Asian Ministers Discuss Education During SCO Meeting
incidents.description: At an Shanghai Cooperation Organization Organization (SCO) meeting aimed at facilitating science, technology, and education cooperation among member states, a series of bilateral meetings occurred among Central Asian States to facilitate education cooperation. Discussed were draft initiatives to establish joint grant competitions, and accelerating efforts to conclude agreement on mutual recognition of higher education qualifications among Central Asian states.

incidents.title: Second Lu Ban Workshop Opens in Kazakhstan
incidents.description: The second Lu Ban workshop in Kazakhstan opened in Astana, with a planned third to open later this year according to the Minister of Science and Higher Education, reports DKNews.

incidents.title: Uzbek Delegation Participates in Conference at the Harbin Engineering University (PRC)
incidents.description: A delegation from the M. Osimi Tajik Technical University participated in an international conference and the opening ceremony of the International Association for Experience Exchange and Personnel Training in Engineering Sciences at Harbin Engineering University in the People's Republic of China, according to Khovar in reference to the M.Osimi University.

incidents.title: China and Uzbekistan Reach Agreements on Creation of Service Centers for Tourism Transport Vehicles
incidents.description: As part of the 3rd Uzbekistan–China Interregional Forum held in Xi'an, Uzbekistan’s Chairman of the Tourism Committee held a series of meetings with representatives of major Chinese companies operating in the fields of tourism, hospitality, and transport infrastructure, reports UzDaily.uz in reference to the Tourism Committee of Uzbekistan. Following the negotiations, preliminary agreements were reached regarding the establishment of a specialized service center in Uzbekistan for the technical maintenance of tourist buses, specifically Yutong, Golden Dragon, King Long, and other models currently supplied to the country's market.

incidents.title: Green Energy Technology MOU Signed between Uzbekistan and China
incidents.description: In the city of Xi'an, a memorandum of cooperation was signed regarding the development of science and innovative technologies in the field of 'green' energy under the framework of the "3rd China–Uzbekistan Interregional Cooperation Forum, reports UzDaily.uz. The document was signed by the National Scientific Research Institute of Renewable Energy Sources under the Ministry of Energy of Uzbekistan, China's Inner Mongolia Technology University, and the China Datang Corporation.

incidents.title: UTK International Logistics Co. Ltd Launches Inaugural Container Train Along the China–Kazakhstan–Uzbekistan–Afghanistan Route
incidents.description: UTK International Logistics Co. Ltd has launched the first container train along the China–Kazakhstan–Uzbekistan–Afghanistan route, reports the Official Telegram channel of "Oztemiryolkonteyner" JSC. The dispatch of a second container train is scheduled for May 30 of this year along this same route.

incidents.title: Russia, Kazakhstan Outline Seven Pillars of Cooperation
incidents.description: In a joint statement issued May 28, Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev and Russian President Vladimir Putin outlined seven pillars of bilateral friendship. The leaders emphasized cross-border trade, environmental cooperation, transport links, joint management of Caspian Sea water resources, expanded use of national currencies, and coordinated responses to external economic pressures. Further, the statement highlighted preserving cultural heritage and protecting traditional spiritual values.

incidents.title: Statement on Necessity of Combating Hate Speech Toward Foreign Workers in Kyrgyzstan
incidents.description: The Ministry of Internal Affairs of Kyrgyzstan issued a statement regarding the necessity of combatting the dissemination of materials on social media that could incite interethnic hatred and discord, particularly against foreign workers, reports Open.kg. This statement emphasized the importance of large-scale infrastructure projects, such as the construction of the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway, the development of the city of Asman, and the Kambar-Ata-1 energy project, which requires skilled foreign specialists, notably Chinese workers. It was also emphasized that all workers arrive with the necessary permits and visas, as well as that the specialists will return to their homeland after the projects are completed.

incidents.title: Tajikistan Hosts International Summit on Water
incidents.description: Tajikistan hosted the Fourth International Conference of the Dushanbe Water Process between 25-28 May. This summit facilitated discussion of UN objectives regarding water access. The summit largely affirmed commitments to previous UN agreements, but there was high-level minister contact between all Central Asian states.

incidents.title: Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, and Kazakhstan Reach Water Sharing Agreement
incidents.description: Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, and Kazakhstan agreed to a summer operating schedule for Bahri Tojik reservoir in Tajikistan. The agreement calls for Tajikistan to share water with Uzbekistan and Kazakhstan's farmers. The agreement was reached on the sidelines of the Dushanbe Water Conference.

incidents.title: Chinese Company Secures the Tashkent–Samarkand Toll Road Construction Contract, Valued at $2.185 Billion
incidents.description: A Chinese company won the tender to construct the Tashkent–Samarkand toll road, which is valued at $2.185 billion, reports UzDaily.uz. Construction work is scheduled to begin in July 2026, and the new 282-kilometer highway will connect the Tashkent, Syrdarya, Jizzakh, and Samarkand regions. Around 85% of financing for this project will come from foreign creditors ($1.857 billion) and 15% from the national budget ($328 million). The China Development Bank, the Export-Import Bank of China, and the Bank of Communications are named as potential financiers.

incidents.title: Kazakhstan Hosts International Forum on Business Accreditation
incidents.description: Kazakhstan hosted representatives from the Eurasian Economic Commission, the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU), Uzbekistan, and China. The focus was on expanding the use of digital accreditation for businesses, and increasing product quality control in the Eurasian market.

incidents.title: Kazakhstan Holds Talks with US Bureau of Reclamation on Irrigation Issues
incidents.description: Kazakh water-management agency Kazvodhoz recently held talks with the US Bureau of Reclamation about ways to reduce water use in the agricultural sector. The US Embassy in Astana facilitated these discussions. According to the UN, Kazakhstan is projected to experience a 50% water shortfall for businesses and households by 2040.

incidents.title: Kazakhstan Works with US Educational Testing Service to Improve Entrance Exams
incidents.description: Kazakhstan is collaborating with the US-based Educational Testing Service to overhaul its college admissions testing process. The country has previously used the Unified National Testing (UNT) exam, but this test recently faced criticism for reinforcing inequality, as well as for its negative psychological impact on students. The ETS-produced “Admissions Insight Test” is expected to replace the UNT over the course of 3 years. The first section of the test will assess subject-specific knowledge, while the other will evaluate the “21st-century” skills of critical thinking and digital literacy.

incidents.title: Russia, Uzbekistan Launch Nuclear Power Project
incidents.description: President Vladimir Putin and Uzbekistan’s President Shavkat Mirziyoyev held a ceremony via live video link celebrating the construction of Uzbekistan’s first nuclear power plant (NPP). Located in the Forish district of Uzbekistan’s Jizzakh region, the NPP will be financed by Russia’s state nuclear energy corporation, Rosatom.

incidents.title: Russia, Kazakhstan Expand Nuclear Science Cooperation
incidents.description: At the St. Petersburg International Economic Forum, Kazakhstan’s Atomic Energy Agency and Russia’s Kurchatov Institute signed a memorandum expanding cooperation in research, knowledge exchange, and nuclear energy expansion. Key focus areas include fusion research, reactor technologies, nuclear medicine, and the digitalization of scientific infrastructure.

incidents.title: Tajikistan, China Banks Discuss Financial Cooperation
incidents.description: On June 2nd, the National Bank of Kazakhstan and the Agricultural Bank of China held talks on increasing bilateral financial cooperation. They discussed expanding Tajikistan's use of digital financial devices, facilitating smoother trade payments, investing in Chinese financial projects in Tajikistan, and opening branches of Chinese banks in Tajikistan.

incidents.title: Russia Helps Uzbekistan Build Nuclear Power Plant
incidents.description: Uzbekistan has begun construction of first nuclear power plant, built with assistance from Russia.

incidents.title: Mississippi National Guard Trains with Uzbekistani Ministry of Emergency Situations on Disaster Response
incidents.description: Members of the Mississippi National Guard conducted disaster response training with the Republic of Uzbekistan’s Ministry of Emergency Situations in Almalyk City, Uzbekistan. The training was part of the Department of War State Partnership Program, which sends National Guard soldiers to partner nations to promote meaningful and mutually beneficial relationships with the US. Uzbekistani officials discussed integrating AI into disaster response to help manage the distribution of essential supplies.

incidents.title: Russian Governor visits Turkmenistan
incidents.description: Governor of Russia’s Astrakhan region Igor Babushkin visited several Orthodox churches in Turkmenistan within the framework of “The Caspian Sea - Sea of Friendship” initiative. Babushkin also held a meeting with the country’s president Serdar Berdimuhamedov where they reportedly discussed issues of bilateral cooperation in the areas of trade, education, logistics, and transport, as well as visited the Joint Turkmen-Russian School in the city of Ashgabat.

incidents.title: Uzbekistan and Russia Expand Energy Partnership
incidents.description: During the St. Petersburg International Economic Forum on June 5, Uzbek and Russian officials discussed critical energy topics, including the supply of oil, motor gasoline, aviation fuel, and refinery feedstock. The dialogue underscored both nations' commitment to maintaining regional energy balance and driving joint industrial development.

incidents.title: Kazakhstan, China Test New Pest Control Agent
incidents.description: In Kazakhstan's Turkestan Region, scientists from Kazakhstan and China trialed the use of a biocontrol agent derived from an entomopathogenic fungus to control locust infestations. The trials successfully demonstrated the effectiveness of the bioagent, offering a potential substitute for chemical insecticides.

incidents.title: Azerbaijan Hosts Baku Energy Week 2026
incidents.description: Azerbaijan hosted ministers, government delegates, and corporate representatives to discuss the future of Azerbaijan's energy sector. $7.5 billion in contracts were signed at the event.

incidents.title: Uzbekistan Floats US, Central Asian Framework for Critical Minerals
incidents.description: Uzbekistan’s Minister of Mining and Geology, Bobir Islamov, said during the C5+1 Critical Minerals Dialogue with the United States in Astana that critical minerals should be seen as the foundation for building resilient supply chains between Central Asia and the US. He explained that the country recently adopted a new subsoil law and tax incentives in an effort to attract Western investors.

incidents.title: Russia and Uzbekistan Expand Media and Communications Cooperation
incidents.description: During a three-day visit to Moscow, Uzbek officials met with Deputy Head of the Russian Presidential Administration Sergey Kiriyenko, Deputy Head of the Presidential Directorate for Strategic Partnerships Dmitry Peskov, Head of the Presidential Directorate for Public Projects Vadim Titov, and Head of the Presidential Directorate for ICT Development Tatiana Matveeva. Joined by media and educational representatives, the officials discussed expanding cooperation across press services, analytical centers, and public organizations.

incidents.title: Kazakhstan Signs Deal with NVIDIA to Construct "Data Center Valley"
incidents.description: Kazakhstan has signed a $10 billion deal with US chipmaker Nvidia and Armenian-American cloud company Firebird to develop a “Data Center Valley” in the country’s Pavlodar region. This deal comes after the recent announcement of the 2029 “Digital Qazaqstan“ strategy by the government. Despite Kazakhstan experiencing a nationwide electricity generation deficit, officials say the infrastructure for the data hub could help meet future electric needs.

incidents.title: Tajikistan and Asian Development Bank Discuss Water Management
incidents.description: Representatives from Tajikistan discussed ADP financing for projects to manage the Bahri Tojik Reservoir, such as modernizing pumping stations and strengthening the reservoir's protective dams.

incidents.title: Uzbekistani President Holds Infrastructure Investment Talks with US
incidents.description: President of Uzbekistan, Shavkat Mirziyoyev, met with John Jovanovic, the President of the Export-Import Bank of the United States, and Ben Black, the CEO of the U.S. International Development Finance Corporation, as part of the recent Tashkent International Investment Forum. An agreement was made to expedite implementation of projects for modernization of the Uzbekistani energy sector. Also reached was a deal to create a joint roadmap for the other investment and technology projects that were discussed.

incidents.title: UNESCO and Kazakhstan host regional dialogue on cooperation in higher education
incidents.description: Delegates from Central Asian education and science ministries, and universities gathered to discuss ways to enhance future education cooperation and exchange.

incidents.title: Russia, Uzbekistan Convene on Trade and Investment
incidents.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev reaffirmed his country’s strategic partnership and alliance with Russia during the 5th Tashkent International Investment Forum. Mirziyoyev emphasized that Uzbek-Russian trade has more than tripled over the last decade and highlighted joint venture projects totaling $47 billion.

incidents.title: Uzbekistan, China Sign Hydropower Cooperation Memorandum
incidents.description: The Uzbek company Uzbekhydroenergo JSC and the China Huaneng Group signed a hydropower cooperation memorandum at the Tashkent International Investment Forum hosted in Uzbekistan. The goal of the memorandum is to coordinate the implementation of hydropower projects, improve hydropower efficiency, and bring Chinese hydropower expertise to Uzbekistan.

incidents.title: Kyrgyzstan to Implement Digital Taxi Platform with Chinese Backing
incidents.description: The Chinese tech company Shenzhen Wuyou Technology Co., Ltd. signed an agreement with the National Investment Fund of the Kyrgyz Republic to establish a national digital taxi service for electric vehicles in Kyrgyzstan. The agreement will also implement electric vehicle charging stations throughout Kyrgyzstan, in addition to new electric vehicles for the ride service.

incidents.title: Turkmenistan Receives Donated Oil Tanker from Azerbaijan
incidents.description: The oil tanker Dostluk was donated by Azerbaijan to Turkmenistan. This will enhance Turkmenistan's Caspian Sea commercial capacity.

incidents.title: Azerbaijan, Turkmenistan Sign Customs Agreement
incidents.description: At a bilateral summit between President Serdar Berdimuhamedov and President Aliyev in Baku, both states signed an agreement that would create a digital system to exchange information of goods being transported and to improve statistical accounting of mutual trade.

incidents.title: Boeing Secures Sale of 14 Aircraft to Tajikistan
incidents.description: At last year's C5+1 summit, Tajikistani airline Somon Air signed an MOU with Boeing for the $3.2 billion purchase of 14 aircraft. A shift towards Boeing in Tajikistan and the wider Central Asia region could mean a highly effective form of soft power for the US, with a decades-long lifespan.

incidents.title: Turkmenistan Expands Trade with Azerbaijan
incidents.description: During a summit between Turkmenistan President Berdymukhamedov and Azerbaijan President Aliyev a raft of trade agreements were signed to expand trade between the two states in energy, industry, agriculture, banking and labor.

incidents.title: Rehabilitation Center to be Built in Uzbekistan with Chinese Company
incidents.description: At the International Tashkent Forum, China CAMC Engineering signed a memorandum with Uzbekistan to begin building a rehabilitation facility for people with disabilities in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. The goal of the new rehabilitation center is to increase the quality of medical and rehabilitation services provided in Uzbekistan.

incidents.title: Kazakhstan and China to Jointly Build Agriculture Park
incidents.description: Kazakhstan’s Atyrau Oil and Gas University (AOGU) established a partnership with China’s Shanghai Aiko Solar Energy Company Limited (AIKO) to build a zero-carbon smart agriculture park on AOGU's new campus to test agricultural solutions for Atyrau's arid climate. The park in Atyrau, Kazakhstan, will serve as a scientific, educational, and technological base that combines renewable energy, artificial intelligence, and digitized farming tools to develop sustainable farming solutions.

incidents.title: Kyrgyzstan to Partially Finance its CKU Railway Contribution with Chinese Loan
incidents.description: Kyrgyzstan's parliament ratified the approval of a loan from the Export-Import Bank of China to finance half of the country's financial contribution to the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan (CKU) railway, a project that will create the first direct rail connection between the three countries. Kyrgyzstan's total contribution to the project will be $609 million, of which the unborrowed half will be financed by its state budget.

incidents.title: Uzbekistan, China Sign $100 Million Loan Agreement
incidents.description: Uzbekistan's national foreign bank approved a 700 million yuan loan from China. The funds will be used to finance the purchase of raw materials and equipment from China and to support investments by Uzbekistan's bank clients.

incidents.title: Kazakhstan and China to Increase Bilateral Trade to $100 Billion
incidents.description: China and Kazakhstan held talks in Urumqi to discuss doubling their current bilateral trade to $100 billion in the coming years. To do this, China and Kazakhstan plan to speed up negotiations on an economic cooperation program for 2027 to 2030.

incidents.title: Kazakhstan-Turkmenistan Business Forum Facilitates Future Trade
Russia Resumes Gas Imports from Turkmenistan
incidents.description: According to Russia’s Gazprom, the country has resumed its import of gas supplies from Turkmenistan. Natural gas exports are a main source of Turkmenistan’s income. Russia’s purchases were halted in 2016 due to a pricing and commercial dispute between the countries respective state-owned gas companies: Gazprom and Turkmengaz.

incidents.title: Uzbekistan, China Partner in Localized Vaccine Production
incidents.description: The director of the Agency for the Development and Pharmaceutical Industry of Uzbekistan, representatives of the China National Biotech Company Limited, and the Uzbek joint pharmaceutical enterprise Yangi Osiyo Xalqaro Biofarmasevtika LLC met to discuss the execution of a project to localize vaccine production in Uzbekistan.

incidents.title: Evander Holyfield Visits Bishkek as Guest of Kyrgyzstan Boxing Association
incidents.description: Former boxer Evander Holyfield is considering opening a boxing academy in Bishkek, according to local media. Holyfield is currently visiting Kyrgyzstan for a July 3rd boxing festival, featuring fighters from across Central Asia. Kyrgyzstan has traditionally been known as a global wrestling hub, and the country’s president, Sadyr Japarov, is a known boxing fan. Money concerns may be a factor in Holyfield’s decision to visit Kyrgyzstan, as he squandered much of his boxing fortune post-retirement.

incidents.title: Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan Commit to Strengthening Their Relations
incidents.description: Kazakhstan's Foreign Minister Kosherbayev and his Turkmenistan counterpart Rashid Meredov met to discuss further areas of cooperation, especially in trade, investment, transportation, energy, and cultural exchanges.

incidents.title: Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan Sign Friendship Treaty
incidents.description: Kazakhstan and Turkmenistan's foreign ministers met to areas of future cooperation regarding regional and international issues. At the conclusion of the meeting they signed a "Treaty on Friendship, Good-Neighbourliness and Cooperation."

incidents.title: Trump Administration Crafts Tungsten Export Deal Between Kazakhstani Government and US Company
incidents.description: The Trump Administration plans to support U.S. company Cove Capital LLC in their joint venture with the National Mining Company of Kazakhstan to develop and extract one of the world’s largest untapped tungsten deposits. The US is using the project to circumvent China’s 80% control of global tungsten production and processing, especially as demand for tungsten is expected to rise dramatically over the next decade. The U.S. Export-Import Bank will provide up to $900 million in financing for the project, and the U.S. International Development Finance Corporation will also contribute up to $700 million in project development funding.

incidents.title: Uzbekistan considers supplying Kyrgyzstan with nearly 20,000 tons of petrol to alleviate oil shortage
incidents.description: Kyrgzstan's Prime Minister Kasymaliev announced that Uzbekistan is open to increasing petrol exports to his country. This comes amidst an energy crisis grips Kyrgyzstan, which imports 90% of its fuel. Kyrgyzstan is struggling to replace Russian imports as the latter's oil production is disrupted by the war against Ukraine.

incidents.title: Turkmenistan Ambassador Meets with Kyrgz Energy Minister
incidents.description: Amidst Kyrgzstan's energy crisis caused by Ukrainian strikes on Russia's oil infrastructure, their energy secretary spoke with Turkmenistan's ambassador about increasing bilateral trade in the energy sector. No agreements were signed.

incidents.title: US AI Hiring Company Takes Steps for Kyrgyzstan Expansion
incidents.description: US-based AI hiring company Truss has registered as a legal entity in Kyrgyzstan. This registration gives the company the ability to assist clients in the country with hiring. This expansion by Truss could provide Kyrgyzstan’s rapidly growing tech market with the ability to search for professional talent at a lower cost.

incidents.title: Tajikistan to Build Fiber-Optic Lines With China
incidents.description: The Communications Service under the Government of the Republic of Tajikistan announced that Tajikistan will build additional fiber-optic communication lines with China, Kyrgyzstan, and Uzbekistan between 2026 and 2028 to develop its digital infrastructure and telecommunication lines.

incidents.title: Turkmenistan, Azerbaijan Explore Energy Cooperation
incidents.description: During the 9th Joint Intergovernmental Commission of Turkmenistan and Azerbaijan, delegates discussed areas for future energy cooperation between Azerbaijan and Turkmenistan. Despite cordial exchanges, no concrete agreements were signed.

incidents.title: US Senator Daines Visits Kazakhstan in Potential Bid for Trans-Caspian Pipeline Creation
incidents.description: In what is likely his last official visit to Central Asia before retirement, Sen. Steve Daines met with leaders in Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan and Turkmenistan. Both sides have remained tight-lipped about the substance of the discussions, but clues suggest that a trans-Caspian pipeline may have been central to the Senator’s agenda. Kazakhstani President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev met with Daines and applauded “the steady growth of trade, economic, and investment interaction between the two countries.”

incidents.title: US Senator Daines Visits Ashgabat in Support of Potential Trans-Caspian Pipeline Project
incidents.description: In what is likely his last official visit to Central Asia before retirement, Sen. Steve Daines met with various leaders in Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan and Turkmenistan. Both sides have remained tight-lipped about the substance of the discussions, but clues suggest that a trans-Caspian pipeline may have been central to the Senator’s agenda. In Turkmenistan, Daines met both President Serdar Berdymukhamedov and his father, Gurbanguly, who is widely acknowledged as the country’s true leader. Construction of a trans-Caspian pipeline has been prevented by territorial disputes, financing debates, and Turkmenistan’s reluctance to export its plentiful natural gas reserves.

incidents.title: Uzbekistan Hosts Talks With China Railway Construction Over Mining Projects
incidents.description: A representative from the China Railway Construction Corporation (CRCC) met with the Uzbek Deputy Minister of Mining and Geology to discuss the corporation's interest in increasing involvement in Uzbekistan mining projects. Both parties agreed to continue discussing collaboration in mining and geology projects in Uzbekistan.

incidents.title: Russia hosts UN Talks on Counterterrorism in Central Asia
incidents.description: The UN Office of Counter-Terrorism organized a regional meeting in Moscow titled “Enhancing Capacities to Prevent the Supply of Weapons to Terrorists in Central Asia.” In attendance at the event were several Russian security officials, including Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov, alongside counterterrorism heads and representatives from Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, and Uzbekistan.

incidents.title: China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan Rail Project Undergoes Review
incidents.description: Wang Xinxi, Vice Chairman of China's State Railways corporation met with his Uzbek counterparts to discuss area to improve the efficiency of the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan Rail project. Parties agreed to continue discussions and to exchange updates on construction progress.

incidents.title: Central Asian States Align with China on AI
incidents.description: 29 countries signed onto the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation (WAICO) agreement, an initiative launched by China to increase AI cooperation globally. Representatives from Russia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, and Uzbekistan, in addition to 24 other countries, signed the agreement to promote global AI governance and mutually agreed-upon AI standards.

incidents.title: China and Kazakhstan Add 28 Round-Trip Flights Weekly
incidents.description: China and Kazakhstan increased the number of flights between the two countries from 124 to 152 per week, in addition to expanding the approved list of Chinese city destinations from Kazakhstan to 11.

incidents.title: Kazakhstan and China Build Digital Hub in Almaty
incidents.description: Kazakhstan and China opened a digital economy hub in Almaty, Kazakhstan, to expand bilateral trade and increase digital economic cooperation. A main component of the digital hub is an industrial park with an estimated infrastructure investment cost of $2 billion, which is expected to generate over $10 billion in revenue.

incidents.title: Turkmenistan, Russia Convene on Bilateral Relations
incidents.description: Turkmenistan’s Foreign Affairs Minister, Rashid Meredov, spoke on the phone with Russia’s Foreign Affairs Minister, Sergey Lavrov to discuss strengthening humanitarian cooperation between the two countries and advancing joint educational and cultural projects. The call was organized at Russia’s request.

incidents.title: Uzbekistan, Pakistan to Use Chinese Corridor to Bypass Afghan Trade Routes
incidents.description: Uzbekistan and Pakistan are expected to sign an amendment to their transit trade agreement allowing bilateral trade operations to be conducted through the China corridor. This would allow Pakistan and Uzbekistan to circumvent contentious trade routes through main corridors in Afghanistan and Iran.

incidents.title: Kyrgyzstan Begins Fuel Imports from China and Belarus
incidents.description: Kyrgyzstan has begun importing fuel and lubricants from China and Belarus after a delegatory visit to China to discuss preliminary agreements. Efficient transport of fuel between China and Kyrgyzstan by road remains a concern.

incidents.title: China and Kazakhstan Initiate Joint Biopesticide Production Projects
incidents.description: China and Kazakhstan signed a memorandum to launch joint biopesticide development projects and localize their production in Kazakhstan.

incidents.title: Kyrgyzstan Approves Plans for Mini Oil Refinery
incidents.description: Kyrgyzstan has agreed to build a $25 million oil refinery, which will have an annual capacity of 450,000 metric tons, as it seeks to boost domestic fuel production and reduce its reliance on Russian imports. The Kyrgyz-Chinese company Central Asian Energy LLC has agreed to finance the project

incidents.title: Kazakh Oil Production Slows Following Drone Strikes on Caspian Pipeline
incidents.description: The Caspian Pipeline Consortium (CPC) terminal on Russia’s Black Sea coast suspended oil loadings following drone strikes on at least five tanker ships since the start of July. Consequently, Kazakhstan has reduced its oil output, calling the decision “purely technical” to prevent storage tanks from overflowing. Reuters has reported that these storage tanks have already reached capacity.

incidents.title: Kyrgyz Energy Minister Visits Kazakhstan for Talks
incidents.description: Kyrgyz Energy Minister Altynbek Rysbekov met his Kazakhstan counterpart for talks about future energy cooperation, especially regards to the electric power industry.

incidents.title: Regional Agreements on Trade, Transportation Deepens Kazakhstan-Uzbekistan Integration
incidents.description: Kazakhstan's Prime Minister Olzhas Beketenov and Uzbek Prime Minister Abdulla Aripov signed trade agreements worth $146 million. Additionally, the agreed to increase rail infrastructure to accommodate growing regional trade.

incidents.title: Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan PMs Discuss Trade Opportunities
incidents.description: Kazakhstan's and Uzbekistan's Prime Minister met to discuss the implementation of previous agreements to increase trade and agro-industrial cooperation.

incidents.title: Turkmenistan and Azerbaijan Launch Digital Exchange Cargo Information
incidents.description: Turkmenistan and Azerbaijan have implemented a digital mechanism for customs officials to access permits and information for cross-border cargo. This will facilitate trans-Caspian trade by reducing paperwork and making customs more efficient.

incidents.title: Russia, Kazakhstan Expect $30 Billion Trade in 2026
incidents.description: Kazakhstan’s President Tokayev met with Putin at the 22nd Kazakhstan-Russia Interregional Cooperation Forum in Omsk, discussing Ukraine, nuclear energy and the strategic partnership. Kazakh Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of the National Economy Serik Zhumangarin told both presidents that a trade target of $30 billion is achievable by the end of the year. More than 22,600 companies with Russian participation now operate in Kazakhstan, close to one third of all foreign-capital enterprises in the country. Zhumangarin credited the 2026-2030 Comprehensive Economic Cooperation Program signed during Tokayev's November 2025 Moscow visit.

incidents.title: Putin Request Negotiations with Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan on Mutual Arms Supplies
incidents.description: Putin signed two separate presidential executive orders instructing the government to open negotiations on amending the military-technical cooperation agreements with Kazakhstan (signed 24 December 2013) and Uzbekistan (29 November 2016). Uzbek coverage links the move to defense-industrial supply chains including cotton cellulose, whereas recent investigations into Kazakh beryllium oxide shipments to Russia, used in military electronics, suggest Russia has become increasingly reliant on Kazakh shipments for military supplies in its war in Ukraine.

incidents.title: Kazakhstan, China Discuss Coal-Industry Investment
incidents.description: Kazakhstan held talks with Chinese investors on its coal-based production projects to develop synthetic fuels, aiming to obtain Chinese investment in its coal industry.

incidents.title: Turkmenistan Hosts Uzbekistan at Business Forum
incidents.description: Uzbekistan and Turkmenistan hosted a forum for government and business representatives to discuss opportunities and obstacles to cooperation in the construction and industrial sectors. Uzbekistan's Ambassador, Ravshanbek Alimov and Turkmenistan's Deputy Chair of the Chamber of Commerce, Azat Nazarov gave speeches at the forum. No agreements were signed by the states.

incidents.title: Uzbekistan’s Uzatom, Russia’s Rosatom Collaborate on Nuclear Power Project
incidents.description: A delegation from Uzbekistan's Atomic Energy Agency (Uzatom) and the NPP Construction Directorate met Rosatom Capital Construction Director Dmitry Volkov in Moscow and agreed to create a joint working group to carry out expert review of design documentation for the integrated nuclear plant in Uzbekistan Jizzakh region. Talks also covered the review procedure and development of Uzbek national personnel competencies. No financing or binding commitment has yet been announced.

incidents.title: China and Kazakhstan Launch Health Center
incidents.description: On July 27th, the Center for One Health Research opened in Almaty, Kazakhstan, to support research in public health, microbiology, and infectious diseases. The center was created by the Chinese Academy of Sciences and Kazakhstan's National Academy of Sciences.

incidents.title: Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan Counterparts Discuss Status of Trade, Eye Future Areas of Cooperation
incidents.description: Uzbekistan's Minister of Investments, Industry, and Trade met with the Deputy Chairman of the Kyrgyz Cabinet of Ministers to discuss future areas of cooperation and trade. Particular attention was paid to cooperation in pharmaceuticals, electrical engineering, and agriculture. At the end, both sides agreed to continue negotiations in these areas.

incidents.title: Russia Resumes Funding for Russian-Tajik Slavonic University
incidents.description: Russia resumed funding for the Russian-Tajik Slavonic University following the appointment of Alexei Zolotukhin as rector. Funding was suspended in March when Ilhomuddin Ibrohimzoda was appointed rector without Russian consultation. Zolotukhin said that Russia halted funding due to failure to follow the required legal process, rather than concerns over Ibrohimzoda personally.

incidents.title: Uzbekistan and Kyrgyzstan Deepen Agricultural, Industrial Cooperation
incidents.description: Representatives from over 200 businesses and the Uzbek and Kyrgyz government discussed ways to enhance bilateral trade, with a particular focus on agricultural and industrial cooperation.

incidents.title: Chinese Company May Help Build $1 Billion Toll Road in Uzbekistan
incidents.description: The China Railway Construction Corporation (CRCC) may assist in building a $1 billion toll ring road in Tashkent, Uzbekistan, with a potential plan to invest $500 million in infrastructure projects within the city. While no official agreement has been reached, Tashkent municipal authorities and the CRCC have signed memorandums for this project.

incidents.title: Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan Draft Agreement on Education Cooperation
incidents.description: Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan's education ministry agree to draft agreement to increase student and educator exchanges and to recognize academic credits earned in each other's universities.

incidents.title: Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan Presidents Identify Future Areas for Negotiation
incidents.description: Uzbekistan President Shavkat Mirziyoyev and Kyrgyz President Japarov meet to discuss future areas of cooperation between their countries. While no major agreements were signed by either side they identified energy and industry as future areas for cooperation

incidents.title: At Summit, Central Asian States Woo Azerbaijan
incidents.description: Summit of Central Asian leaders met to discuss opportunities for enhanced regional cooperation and trade.

incidents.title: International Dairy Foods Association Highlights Growth Potential of Uzbekistan and Other Central Asian States
incidents.description: In a new report, the International Dairy Foods Association singled out Central Asia as a region for future growth in U.S. dairy exports. According to the IDFA, the country that provides the most opportunity for export expansion in the short-term is Uzbekistan, which has recently registered stable economic growth and has a business environment favorable to US exports.

incidents.title: Central Asia & Azerbaijan Agree to Framework for Future Negotiation
incidents.description: Central Asian Leaders agreed to further regional partnership, including establishing a unified tourist visa for foreign citizens visiting region, continue infrastructure projects.

incidents.title: US Army Band Performs Alongside Kazakhstani Choir During Partnership Program Visit
incidents.description: During a two-week visit to Kazakhstan as part of the Arizona National Guard's State Partnership Program, the US 108th Army Band performed several songs with the Kazakhstan National Guard Choir. The AZ National Guard’s long-term partnership with Kazakhstan brings together US and Kazakhstani Soldiers through emergency response training sessions, cyber cooperation workshops, and medical response classes.

incidents.title: Chinese Airline Will Launch New Flights to Kazakhstan
incidents.description: The Chinese company Urumqi Airlines plans to launch three new routes between Kazakhstan and China. The ministry claims that the proposed flights would increase tourism and strengthen trade between the two countries.

incidents.title: Kyrgyzstan Increases Barley Imports from Russia, Kazakhstan
incidents.description: From January to May 2026, Kyrgyzstan’s barley imports from Russia grew by 281%, making Russia the country’s second-largest barley supplier. Imports from Kazakhstan—Kyrgyzstan’s largest barley supplier—also rose, increasing by nearly 286% year-on-year.

incidents.title: China And Kazakhstan Sign Three-Year Currency Exchange Agreement
incidents.description: The People’s Bank of China and the National Bank of Kazakhstan signed a currency swap agreement that will remain in place for three years, with the possibility of extension. The goal of this agreement is to allow each of the central banks to exchange their respective currencies directly and expand the use of national currencies in bilateral trade relations.

incidents.title: Central Asia and Azerbaijan Expand Transportation Coordination
incidents.description: Azerbaijan and Five Central Asian states signed agreements to deepen economic and infrastructure integration (i.e. streamlining administrative procedures at borders for cargo transit)

incidents.title: Uzbekistan and China Develop AI System for Satellite
incidents.description: Uzbekistan’s national space agency, Uzbekcosmos, is developing a satellite with an onboard AI system in collaboration with the Chinese aerospace company STAR.VISION. Uzbekcosmos specified that the satellite could be used for agricultural and environmental monitoring, but the launch date remains undetermined.

incidents.title: Uzbekistan and China's AI Satellite Launches
incidents.description: On August 5th, a Chinese-built satellite that uses an Uzbek-developed AI module was launched from Shandong province in China.

incidents.title: Caspian Pipeline Consortium Suspends Operations
incidents.description: The Caspian Pipeline, the main export route for Kazakh crude oil, carrying roughly 1.8% of global oil supply from Kazakhstan to Russia’s Black Sea coast, has reportedly suspended operations on August 5 due to safety concerns following recent Ukrainian drone attacks.
