incidents.description: The National Centre “Russia” and Uzbekistan’s Centre of Islamic Civilization signed an additional agreement to their April 2026 memorandum of cooperation to stage cross Days of Russia and Uzbekistan in 2027. Days of Uzbekistan will be held on the National Centre’s venues in Moscow in March 2027, and the Uzbek side will host the Days of Russia.

incidents.title: Russian FM Lavrov Pledges Arms and Protections at Tajik-Afghan Border
incidents.description: During his speech at the SCO conference on security in Central Asia and Afghanistan, Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov said Russia prioritizes strengthening the Tajik-Afghan border and is taking measures to ensure timely delivery of weapons, military equipment, and technical border-protection systems to Tajikistan. He added that terrorist and extremist groups bordering Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, and Uzbekistan try and infiltrate the region “disguised as refugees and even tourists” and warned that any country, including Central Asian states, could fall victim to western geopolitical expansion.

incidents.title: Russia Denies Transport of Kazakh Grain to Baltic Sea
incidents.description: Russian Railways has denied transport of Kazakh Grain through its territory to access the Baltic Sea. Due to frequent attacks on infrastructure and ships, Russia has redirected a majority of its grain exports from the Black Sea to ports in the Baltic, the Far East, and the Caspian Sea. At the same time, Estonia banned the transit of Russian grain and Latvia is reportedly preparing similar measures. Kazakh exporters sought to take advantage of the freed-up capacity at Estonia’s ports, but Russian Railways rejected their applications for transit through Russia to Estonia, citing a lack of capacity. Kazakhstan’s alternative to Russia transit routes is the Trans-Caspian International Transport Route (TITR) via Georgia, however, capacity at Georgia’s port is limited, and logistics costs are much higher. Meanwhile, Russian barley exports to Iran are increasing and Kazakh barley producers risk losing the market. Several factors explain this trend: the tenge (Kazakhstan’s currency) has strengthened by roughly 20% this year, there is a shortage of transport vessels in the Caspian Sea, and the freight costs have increased dramatically, from $17 to $95 per ton.

incidents.title: SCO Strengthens Cooperation with Raft of Agreements
incidents.description: At a meeting of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) Council of Heads of Government, a raft of agreements were signed. Among them were regular agreements establishing the SCO's 2027 budget, an action plan for implementing previously agreed upon trade targets, as well as new agreements to establish a SCO digital platform for streamlining freight transport and a database for investment projects in the industrial sector of SCO Member states.

incidents.title: Uzbekistan Presdient Hosts Turkmenistan Foreign Minister
incidents.description: Uzbekistan President Shavkat Mirziyoyev hosted Turkmenistan's Deputy Chairman of the Cabinet of Ministers and Foreign Minister Rashid Meredow to discuss their future bilateral relations. Of particular focus was their growing bilateral trade and freight transportation. No agreements were signed but both agreed to continue discussions about how to deepen trade across all domains.

incidents.title: Kyrgyzstan, Russia’s Tatarstan Open Joint Manufacturing Plant
incidents.description: Kyrgyzstan and Russia’s Tatarstan region opened a new manufacturing facility, “Skat Pro”, specializing in products for energy and infrastructure facilities.

incidents.title: US Company Signs Coal-Processing Cooperation Agreement with Uzbekistan
incidents.description: The Tashkent Region Administration signed a memorandum of cooperation with US-based Powerscape Global to explore energy and industrial projects using advanced gasification technologies. The proposed projects involve converting locally mined coal into products for electricity generation, fertilizer production, and fuel applications. Project scope, investment amounts, and implementation timelines have not yet been established.

incidents.title: US Firm Secures Export License for 45,000 NVIDIA GPUs for Kazakhstan AI Facility
incidents.description: US-based Firebird announced that it secured an American export license for 45,000 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs for the first phase of Kazakhstan's AI Factory at Data Center Valley. The first phase, under construction with Kazakhtelecom, has an estimated investment of $5 billion and planned computing infrastructure capacity of up to 109 MW. Commercial operations are targeted for the third quarter of 2027. Firebird also announced plans for further expansion and an AI innovation initiative in Kazakhstan.

incidents.title: Uzbekistan President Agrees to Cooperation Roadmap with US Investment Firm
incidents.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev met with Todd Boehly, co-founder and CEO of U.S. investment company Eldridge Industries, to discuss future cooperation in mining, metallurgy, construction, and digital solutions for urban infrastructure. At the conclusion of the meeting, the parties agreed to adopt a joint roadmap for further cooperation. No specific investment commitments or signed project contracts were announced.

incidents.title: Kazakhstan and US Discuss Aviation Security Requirements for Direct Flights
incidents.description: The Aviation Administration of Kazakhstan met with representatives of the US Transportation Security Administration (TSA) during ICAO Aviation Security Week in Astana. Discussions focused on requirements for launching direct flights between Kazakhstan and the United States, including Air Astana's aviation security program, passenger information systems, and airport security assessments. The parties also discussed regulatory cooperation and information exchange. No formal agreement was announced.

incidents.title: US-Based Kraken Receives Preliminary Approval to Expand in Kazakhstan
incidents.description: US-based cryptocurrency exchange Kraken, through its parent company Payward, announced that it received in-principle approval from Kazakhstan's Astana Financial Services Authority to operate a digital asset trading facility, provide digital asset custody, and conduct investment-related activities in the Astana International Financial Centre. The approval represents a preliminary regulatory step toward establishing local operations rather than a final operating license.

incidents.title: US Commerce Department Organizes Trans-Caspian Trade Corridor Meeting in Kyrgyzstan
incidents.description: The US Department of Commerce's Commercial Law Development Program organized the third meeting of the Trans-Caspian Trade Route Expert Group in Bishkek from October 19–21. Participants reviewed progress on the corridor's development, discussed customs simplification and a joint action plan, and examined opportunities to attract American investment and establish partnerships with US transport and logistics companies. No new binding agreement was identified.

incidents.title: Apple Pay and Google Pay Become Available for Locally Issued Bank Cards in Uzbekistan
incidents.description: Apple Pay launched in Uzbekistan on October 27, initially supporting Visa and Mastercard cards issued by eight Uzbek banks and financial institutions, according to the Central Bank. Google Wallet also became available for locally issued cards from participating banks. Google Pay had previously been announced on October 19, but local card enrollment became available on October 27. Integration with the national Uzcard and Humo payment systems remains under development for Apple Pay.

incidents.title: Kyrgyz, Chinese Marketing Associations Sign Memorandum
incidents.description: The Kyrgyz Marketing Association and the China Advertising Association, a state-run organization, signed a cooperation memorandum at the 33rd China International Advertising Festival. The agreement seeks to exchange best practices between Chinese and Kyrgyz advertisers via the hosting of joint conferences and forums, as well as to increase bilateral investment advertising.

incidents.title: Turkmenistan, China Business Community Discuss Investment Opportunities
incidents.description: In Ashgabat, Turkmenistan, representatives of Turkmenistani and Chinese business community discussed investment opportunities in each other's industry and tech sectors.

incidents.title: Turkmenistan Sign Multiple Contracts, MOUs to Exploit Caspian Fossil Fuels
incidents.description: Turkmenistan's state energy firm signed a memorandum of understanding with China National Offshore Oil Corporation (CNOOC) to expand cooperation in Caspian oil exploitation. Similar agreements were also signed with Malaysian, Kazakhstani, and Uzbekistani partners, with a total of three contracts and two MOUs signed collectively.
